tt1# Hero pipeline variant
2 
3`pipeline.py` adapts `moe_pipeline` to the model in [`moe_hero_ep`](../moe_hero_ep/README.md), preserving
4latent/shared experts, SConv, absolute local/global attention positions, and QB
5router updates. Standard 1F1B is the default. Each process initializes only its
6own stage. CPU tests compare sequential-stage hidden states, routing statistics,
7losses, and gradients against the unsplit model. Run them with
8`uv run pytest experiments/grug/moe_hero_pipeline/test_pipeline.py`. The
9checkpoint continuation test compares two AdamW updates after restore with an
10uninterrupted run, including a changing learning rate and a changed stage split.
11 
12The synthetic runner can save and resume complete pipeline checkpoints.
13`--main-hero-recipe` uses FP32 parameters, BF16 compute and compute-scaled
14MuonH; it requires `--optimizer muonh` and an explicit `--processes-per-task`
15count. The legacy AdamW default is a bring-up configuration. The historical
16long-context recipe explicitly selects BF16 MuonH and both host offloads.
17Production continuation and long-run training stability remain unvalidated.
18 
19Set `--context-axis-size` to split each sequence across context-parallel
20devices. Sequence length must be divisible by this size. Context replicas do
21not increase the global batch size or its required divisibility; data and
22expert parallelism still do.
23 
24Set `--checkpoint-root` to restore the latest complete `step-N` checkpoint and
25`--checkpoint-every-steps` to save at that interval and on the final step. Keep
26`--steps` at the same total update count when restarting: it sets the MuonH
27schedule as well as the stopping point. The checkpoint contains model weights,
28optimizer state, and pending QB router updates under global layer paths, so a
29run may resume with a different pipeline layer split. The checkpoint root must
30be shared by every worker. A checkpoint written by the standard Hero FSDP
31trainer has a different state tree, including optional master and EMA weights;
32loading that format into this pipeline has not been implemented or validated.
33 
34The current optimizer normalizes each layer's routed expert bank together, matching
35the stacked EP model. Set `--expert-normalization per_expert` for a comparison;
36the shared `GrugMoeMuonHConfig.expert_normalization` selects this choice.
37The historical hardware runs used the earlier per-expert behavior; they do not
38validate this normalization correction. The current optimizer and frozen-QB
39options have CPU numerical/state-transition coverage.
40 
41QB bias adapts after each update by default. Set `--qb-bias-mode frozen` to
42retain the current pending bias while continuing to train expert and router weights. This controls the QB bias
43only; it does not freeze the router weights. Frozen QB has CPU state-transition
44coverage but has not been evaluated for SFT or RL training quality.
45 
46## Historical validated result
47 
48The full 535,477,106,688-parameter, 48-layer model completed ten finite synthetic
49updates at sequence length 65,536 on 192 H100s in `cw-rno2a`. The recipe uses
50PP24/EP8, one process per eight-GPU worker, batch 384, 48 microbatches, six expert
51transport waves, and FA4 (`gpu_fa4_cute`). No FP8 was needed.
52 
53| Schedule | Median reported step time | Median MFU | Validation |
54| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
55| Standard 1F1B | 174.432 s | 15.523% | Ten finite updates, all 24 workers exited successfully |
56| DualPipeV with backward-task waits | 550.704 s | 4.917% | Ten finite updates, all 24 workers exited successfully; extr
 >a recomputation/offload and telemetry enabled |
57 
58Keep 1F1B as the working recipe. The reported timer excludes some global loss
59collection and inter-step overhead. These are systems measurements from fresh
60initialization with synthetic data, not training-quality results. The complete
61scaling table, negative results, dependency findings, and W&B links are in
62[experiment #9277](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/9277).
63 
64PP24 gives two transformer layers per stage, reducing the parameters and
65optimizer state owned by each worker. EP8 keeps expert communication within
66an eight-GPU worker's NVLink fabric. CP1 was the initial working integration;
67this layout was chosen to fit the model and then fill the 1F1B pipeline, rather
68than through a matched comparison with PP8/EP32/CP4. More pipeline stages also
69increase the number of microbatches needed to amortize pipeline fill and drain.
70The subsequent PP24/EP4/CP2 diagnostic completed ten updates at batch 96,
7168.539 seconds/update and 9.877% MFU. It reduced tokens per GPU and tokens per
72update; differing batch sizes and attention-helper versions prevent an isolated
73CP comparison. No matched Megatron layout benchmark was performed.
74 
75## Historical runtime requirements
76 
77The measured runs used JAXPP `46b8443eed01f54688dd24ae451203a504b1cff8` with
78local overlays. A stock installation of that pin is insufficient. Required
79pieces are:
80 
81- Preserve Host/Device memory targets during mesh rebinding
82  ([NVIDIA/jaxpp#13](https://github.com/NVIDIA/jaxpp/issues/13)).
83- Keep activation D2H copies in the forward partition and preserve pinned-host
84  intermediate shardings. This saved 12 GiB/device at eight outstanding
85  microbatches in the 24-layer diagnostic.
86- Include the Dime2 send-buffer lifetime fix from upstream
87  [78458f8](https://github.com/NVIDIA/jaxpp/commit/78458f8b258f0fd467be13b4b8e7056a853e320b).
88- Precompile and warm local tasks with disposable inputs before pipeline
89  transfers; initialize adjacent communication channels before stepping.
90- Park real device state on host during disposable warmup, then restore its
91  original values and shardings.
92 
93The runner retains `--synchronize-devices-after-step`: two unsynchronized full
94m8 trials produced NaNs, while synchronized trials passed. This is a timing
95workaround with an unresolved root cause. Do not remove it from the validated
96recipe based only on successful small tests.
97 
98Use the `pipeline` dependency environment and CUDA toolchain. After applying
99the dependency overlays, reproduce the worker configuration with:
100 
101```bash
102XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_ALLOCATOR=cuda_async \
103XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false XLA_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=0.91 \
104JAX_ENABLE_PGLE=false XLA_FLAGS=--xla_gpu_enable_command_buffer= \
105CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER JAXPP_DISABLE_SCHEDULE_TASK_FUSION=1 \
106uv run --no-sync python -m iris.hooks.multigpu_main --nproc 1 --devices-per-proc 8 -- \
107  python -u -m experiments.grug.moe_hero_pipeline.pipeline_smoke --full-hero \
108    --schedule standard_1f1b --stages 24 --expert-axis-size 8 \
109    --microbatches 48 --batch-size 384 --sequence-length 65536 --expert-waves 6 \
110    --optimizer muonh --expert-normalization per_expert \
111    --offload-opt-state --offload-activations \
112    --park-state-during-warmup --synchronize-devices-after-step \
113    --compilation-cache /tmp/hero-pp-jax-cache \
114    --steps 10 --run-id <unique-run-id>
115```
116 
117Iris must supply the distributed coordinator and ranks for 24 eight-GPU workers.
118Keep ten steps for matched diagnostics: the configured weight-decay schedule
119depends on the requested step count. BFC and larger preallocation trials failed;
120retain the allocator settings above when reproducing this result.
121 
122The measured source base was `96da2a6cdce401187239846957687fdde22cf8a5` plus
123local model/runner/dependency overlays. Launch manifests record exact hashes in
124`scratch/hero-h100-20260916/`; `full65k-m48-sync24-evidence.json` retains the
125baseline evidence. These ignored artifacts are not a published reproduction
126package. Subsequent runner cleanup removed per-leaf finite-state diagnostics
127and per-step memory dumps; it has not been benchmarked again on hardware.
128 
129[PR #9662](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/pull/9662) extends this
130foundation with a GB200 launcher, tracked runtime setup, checkpoint/data support
131and bounded main-recipe hardware validation.

99    if args.stop_after_step is not None and not 1 <= args.stop_after_step <= args.steps:
100        parser.error("stop-after-step must be between 1 and steps")
101 
102    if args.checkpoint_every_steps < 0 or (args.checkpoint_every_steps and not args.checkpoint_root):

104 
105    if (args.schedule == AutomaticPipelineSchedule.DUALPIPE_V) != (args.physical_stages is not None):
106        raise ValueError("DualPipeV requires physical-stages; other schedules use one logical stage per physical stage")
107    return args

4"""Topology-independent checkpoints for the Hero pipeline variant."""

6import json
7from dataclasses import dataclass
8 
9import jax
10import optax
11from jaxtyping import PyTree
12from levanter import mpmd_checkpoint
13from levanter.checkpoint import discover_checkpoint_candidates
14from levanter.checkpoint import save_checkpoint as save_levanter_checkpoint
15from rigging.filesystem.storage_path import prefix_join
16 
17from experiments.grug.moe_hero_pipeline.pipeline import (
18    GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState,
19    GrugMoePipelineStage,
20    split_pipeline_stage,
21)
22 
23 
24@jax.tree_util.register_dataclass
25@dataclass(frozen=True)
26class HeroPipelineCheckpointState:
27    """Full Hero state with layers independent of their pipeline partition."""
28 
29    params: GrugMoePipelineStage
30    opt_state: optax.OptState
31    pending_qb_betas: tuple[jax.Array, ...]
32 
33 
34def _merge_stages(stages: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...]) -> GrugMoePipelineStage:
35    first, last = stages[0], stages[-1]
36    return GrugMoePipelineStage(
37        token_embed=first.token_embed,
38        embed_norm=first.embed_norm,
39        embed_gated_norm=first.embed_gated_norm,
40        output_proj=last.output_proj,
41        blocks=tuple(block for stage in stages for block in stage.blocks),
42        final_norm=last.final_norm,
43        final_gated_norm=last.final_gated_norm,
44        config=first.config,
45        start_layer=0,
46        end_layer=last.end_layer,
47    )
48 
49 
50def checkpoint_state(state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState) -> HeroPipelineCheckpointState:
51    """Expose stage-local parameters, optimizer state, and router updates by layer."""
52    arrays = mpmd_checkpoint.checkpoint_arrays(state)
53    optimizer = jax.tree.map(
54        lambda *values: _merge_stages(values) if isinstance(values[0], GrugMoePipelineStage) else values[0],
55        *arrays.opt_state,
56        is_leaf=lambda value: isinstance(value, GrugMoePipelineStage),
57    )
58    return HeroPipelineCheckpointState(
59        params=_merge_stages(arrays.trainable_params),
60        opt_state=optimizer,
61        pending_qb_betas=tuple(
62            beta for stage in arrays.pending_qb_betas for beta in mpmd_checkpoint.unstack_checkpoint_layers(stage)
63        ),
64    )
65 
66 
67def _pipeline_state(
68    canonical: HeroPipelineCheckpointState, exemplar: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState
69) -> GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState:
70    layer_counts = tuple(len(stage.blocks) for stage in exemplar.trainable_params)
71    params = split_pipeline_stage(canonical.params, len(layer_counts), layer_counts=layer_counts)
72    optimizer = tuple(
73        jax.tree.map(
74            lambda value, index=index: (
75                split_pipeline_stage(value, len(layer_counts), layer_counts=layer_counts)[index]
76                if isinstance(value, GrugMoePipelineStage)
77                else value
78            ),
79            canonical.opt_state,
80            is_leaf=lambda value: isinstance(value, GrugMoePipelineStage),
81        )
82        for index in range(len(layer_counts))
83    )
84    pending = tuple(
85        mpmd_checkpoint.stack_checkpoint_layers(
86            canonical.pending_qb_betas[stage.start_layer : stage.end_layer], target.sharding
87        )
88        for stage, target in zip(params, exemplar.pending_qb_betas, strict=True)
89    )
90    return GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState(params, optimizer, pending)
91 
92 
93def save_checkpoint(root: str, state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState, *, step: int, contract: dict) -> str:
94    """Publish a complete Hero pipeline checkpoint using Levanter's step layout."""
95    path = prefix_join(root, f"step-{step}")
96    return save_levanter_checkpoint(checkpoint_state(state), step, path, metadata={"training_config": contract})
97 
98 
99def restore_checkpoint(
100    root: str, state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState, shardings: PyTree, *, contract: dict
101) -> tuple[GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState, int]:
102    """Restore the latest complete Hero checkpoint into the compiled stage layout."""
103    candidates = discover_checkpoint_candidates(root)
104    if not candidates:
105        return state, 0
106    checkpoint = candidates[-1]
107    saved_config = checkpoint.metadata.get("training_config")
108    if saved_config is not None and saved_config != json.loads(json.dumps(contract)):
109        raise ValueError("Hero checkpoint training configuration does not match")
110    arrays = mpmd_checkpoint.checkpoint_arrays(state)
111    canonical = checkpoint_state(arrays)
112    loaded = mpmd_checkpoint.restore_checkpoint(
113        canonical, checkpoint.path, jax.tree.map(lambda value: value.sharding, canonical)
114    )
115    restored = _pipeline_state(loaded, arrays)
116    # Compilation can mark unused state leaves with an empty MPMD placement.
117    # Keep their initialized placement so their saved values remain representable.
118    destination_shardings = jax.tree.map(
119        lambda original, compiled: (
120            original._mpmd_sharding
121            if not isinstance(compiled, jax.sharding.Sharding) and not compiled.mesh_ids
122            else compiled
123        ),
124        state,
125        shardings,
126    )
127    # Canonical scalar counters are replicated on a temporary checkpoint mesh.
128    # Ordinary JAX stages need their training mesh back before the next update.
129    restored = jax.tree.map(
130        lambda value, target: jax.device_put(value, target) if isinstance(target, jax.sharding.Sharding) else value,
131        restored,
132        destination_shardings,
133    )
134    return mpmd_checkpoint.wrap_checkpoint_arrays(restored, destination_shardings), checkpoint.step

92def make_pipeline_mesh(
93    config: GrugMoePipelineConfig,
94    *,
95    expert_axis_size: int,
96    context_axis_size: int = 1,
97    replica_axis_size: int | None = None,
98):
99    """Build the concrete Grug mesh and wrap it as a JaxPP MPMD mesh."""
100    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
101    if replica_axis_size is None:
102        replica_axis_size = max(1, jax.process_count() // config.mpmd_stages)
103    if min(expert_axis_size, context_axis_size, replica_axis_size) <= 0:
104        raise ValueError("expert, context, and replica axis sizes must be positive")
105    fixed_axes = config.mpmd_stages * replica_axis_size * expert_axis_size * context_axis_size
106    if jax.device_count() % fixed_axes != 0:
107        raise ValueError(
108            f"device count {jax.device_count()} must be divisible by stages ({config.mpmd_stages}) * "
109            f"replicas ({replica_axis_size}) * experts ({expert_axis_size}) * context ({context_axis_size})"
110        )
111 
112    data_axis_size = jax.device_count() // fixed_axes
113    shape = (config.mpmd_stages, replica_axis_size, data_axis_size, context_axis_size, expert_axis_size, 1)
114    axis_names = (_PIPELINE_AXIS, "replica_dcn", "data", "context", "expert", "model")
115    devices = np.asarray(jax.devices(), dtype=object).reshape(shape)
116    mesh = Mesh(devices, axis_names, axis_types=(AxisType.Explicit,) * len(axis_names))
117    if mesh.is_multi_process:
118        local_stages = {int(np.argwhere(devices == device)[0][0]) for device in jax.local_devices()}
119        if len(local_stages) != 1:
120            raise ValueError(f"each JAX process must own exactly one pipeline stage; got {sorted(local_stages)}")
121    return mesh, pp.MpmdMesh(mesh, _PIPELINE_AXIS)

124class GrugMoePipelineStage(eqx.Module):
125    """The parameters and layer range owned by one pipeline stage.
126 
127    Embedding fields are None except on the first stage; output and final-norm
128    fields are None except on the last stage. Every stage owns its block range.
129    """
130 
131    token_embed: jax.Array | None
132    embed_norm: RMSNorm | None
133    embed_gated_norm: GatedNorm | None
134    output_proj: jax.Array | None
135    blocks: tuple[Block, ...]
136    final_norm: RMSNorm | None
137    final_gated_norm: GatedNorm | None
138    config: GrugModelConfig = eqx.field(static=True)
139    start_layer: int = eqx.field(static=True)
140    end_layer: int = eqx.field(static=True)
141 
142    @eqx.filter_checkpoint
143    @named_call
144    def embed(self, token_ids: Int[Array, "B S"]) -> Float[Array, "B S D"]:
145        if self.token_embed is None or self.embed_norm is None or self.embed_gated_norm is None:
146            raise ValueError("only stage 0 owns the token embedding")
147        # Recompute lookup/norm intermediates from IDs: retaining them costs several
148        # full-width tensors per microbatch even when block carries are offloaded.
149        hidden = _embedding_gather(self.token_embed, token_ids)
150        return self.embed_gated_norm(self.embed_norm(hidden))
151 
152    @named_call
153    def run_blocks(
154        self,
155        hidden: Float[Array, "B S D"],
156        mask: AttentionMask | jax.Array | None,
157    ) -> tuple[Float[Array, "B S D"], dict[str, jax.Array]]:
158        if mask is None:
159            mask = AttentionMask.causal()
160 
161        cfg = self.config
162        segment_ids = mask.segment_ids if isinstance(mask, AttentionMask) else None
163        if segment_ids is not None:
164            ids = _batch_reshard(segment_ids[0])
165            segment_ids = (ids, ids)
166        short_mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, sliding_window=cfg.sliding_window, segment_ids=segment_ids)
167        long_mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, sliding_window=None, segment_ids=segment_ids)
168        if cfg.remat_mode == "save_moe":
169            remat_policy = jax.checkpoint_policies.save_only_these_names(*MOE_REMAT_SAVE_NAMES)
170        elif cfg.remat_mode == OFFLOAD_CARRY_REMAT_MODE:
171            # Block names its input inside remat, so the backward residual includes a
172            # host copy of the stage input instead of retaining it in device memory.
173            remat_policy = jax.checkpoint_policies.save_and_offload_only_these_names(
174                names_which_can_be_saved=[],
175                names_which_can_be_offloaded=[LAYER_CARRY_REMAT_NAME],
176                offload_src="device",
177                offload_dst=_HOST_MEMORY_KIND,
178            )
179        else:
180            remat_policy = None
181 
182        batch_size, seq_len = hidden.shape[:2]
183        long_bounds, valid = fa4_cute_segment_bounds(
184            long_mask, batch_size=batch_size, seq_len=seq_len, sliding_window=None
185        )
186        short_bounds, _ = fa4_cute_segment_bounds(
187            short_mask, batch_size=batch_size, seq_len=seq_len, sliding_window=cfg.sliding_window
188        )
189        # Metadata contains global key positions; shard its query dimension like the residual.
190        bounds_spec = P(BATCH_AXES, _seq_axis(get_abstract_mesh()))
191        long_bounds, short_bounds, valid = (reshard(value, bounds_spec) for value in (long_bounds, short_bounds, valid))
192        block_metrics = []
193        for local_index, block in enumerate(self.blocks):
194            layer_index = self.start_layer + local_index
195            is_long = (layer_index + 1) % cfg.global_every == 0 or layer_index == cfg.num_layers - 1
196            layer_mask = long_mask.with_fa4_bounds(long_bounds if is_long else short_bounds, valid)
197            hidden, metrics = eqx.filter_checkpoint(block, policy=remat_policy)(
198                hidden,
199                layer_mask,
200                disable_rope=is_long,
201                is_global=is_long,
202            )
203            block_metrics.append(metrics)
204 
205        stacked = jax.tree.map(lambda *values: jnp.stack(values), *block_metrics)
206        reduced = reduce_moe_routing_stats(
207            stacked,
208            num_experts=cfg.num_experts,
209            num_experts_per_token=cfg.num_experts_per_token,
210        )
211        return hidden, {f"{key}_per_layer": value for key, value in reduced.items()}
212 
213    @named_call
214    def finish(self, hidden: Float[Array, "B S D"]) -> Float[Array, "B S D"]:
215        if self.final_norm is None or self.final_gated_norm is None:
216            raise ValueError("only the final stage owns the final norms")
217        return self.final_gated_norm(self.final_norm(hidden))
218 
219    @named_call
220    def cross_entropy_loss(
221        self,
222        hidden: Float[Array, "B S D"],
223        token_ids: Int[Array, "B S"],
224        loss_weight: Float[Array, "B S"],
225        *,
226        logsumexp_weight: float | None,
227        reduction: str = "mean",
228    ) -> jax.Array:
229        if self.output_proj is None:
230            raise ValueError("only the final stage owns the output projection")
231        # Shift global token IDs so labels include the next token across CP boundaries.
232        token_ids = _batch_reshard(token_ids)
233        labels = jnp.pad(token_ids[:, 1:], ((0, 0), (0, 1))).astype(jnp.int32)
234        return fused_linear_softmax_cross_entropy_loss(
235            hidden,
236            self.output_proj,
237            labels,
238            weight=loss_weight.astype(jnp.float32),
239            reduction=reduction,
240            logsumexp_weight=logsumexp_weight,
241            dtype=jnp.float32,
242            implementation="xla_fast_bwd",
243            block_sizes=_CE_BLOCK_SIZES,
244        )

287def split_pipeline_stage(
288    stage: GrugMoePipelineStage,
289    num_stages: int,
290    *,
291    layer_counts: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
292) -> tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...]:
293    """Partition contiguous Hero layers while keeping boundary modules on edge stages."""
294    blocks = stage.blocks
295    if layer_counts is None:
296        ranges = evenly_partition_layers(len(blocks), num_stages)
297    else:
298        if len(layer_counts) != num_stages:
299            raise ValueError(f"expected {num_stages} layer counts, got {len(layer_counts)}")
300        if any(count <= 0 for count in layer_counts):
301            raise ValueError(f"layer counts must be positive, got {layer_counts}")
302        if sum(layer_counts) != len(blocks):
303            raise ValueError(f"layer counts sum to {sum(layer_counts)}, but model has {len(blocks)} layers")
304        boundaries = np.cumsum((0, *layer_counts))
305        ranges = tuple((int(start), int(end)) for start, end in itertools.pairwise(boundaries))
306    stages = []
307    for stage_index, (start_layer, end_layer) in enumerate(ranges):
308        is_first = stage_index == 0
309        is_last = stage_index == num_stages - 1
310        stages.append(
311            GrugMoePipelineStage(
312                token_embed=stage.token_embed if is_first else None,
313                embed_norm=stage.embed_norm if is_first else None,
314                embed_gated_norm=stage.embed_gated_norm if is_first else None,
315                output_proj=stage.output_proj if is_last else None,
316                blocks=blocks[start_layer:end_layer],
317                final_norm=stage.final_norm if is_last else None,
318                final_gated_norm=stage.final_gated_norm if is_last else None,
319                config=stage.config,
320                start_layer=stage.start_layer + start_layer,
321                end_layer=stage.start_layer + end_layer,
322            )
323        )
324    return tuple(stages)

327def initialize_stage_local_pipeline_state(
328    model_config: GrugModelConfig,
329    optimizer: optax.GradientTransformation,
330    mp_policy: jmp.Policy,
331    mpmd_mesh,
332    *,
333    num_stages: int,
334    seed: int = 0,
335    stage_to_mpmd_index: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
336    offload_opt_state: bool = False,
337) -> tuple[GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState, tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...]]:
338    """Initialize only the layers owned by this process, with canonical hero keys."""
339    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
340    if stage_to_mpmd_index is None:
341        stage_to_mpmd_index = tuple(range(num_stages))
342    if len(stage_to_mpmd_index) != num_stages:
343        raise ValueError("each logical stage needs one physical placement")
344    ranges = evenly_partition_layers(model_config.num_layers, num_stages)
345    params, states, betas, static_stages = [], [], [], []
346    for stage_index, (start, end) in enumerate(ranges):
347        physical_index = stage_to_mpmd_index[stage_index]
348        stage_mesh = mpmd_mesh.unstack[physical_index]
349 
350        def initialize(start=start, end=end):
351            cfg = model_config
352            embed_key, out_key, embed_gn_key, final_gn_key, *block_keys = jax.random.split(
353                jax.random.PRNGKey(seed), cfg.num_layers + 4
354            )
355            first, last = start == 0, end == cfg.num_layers
356            stage = GrugMoePipelineStage(
357                token_embed=(
358                    jax.sharding.reshard(
359                        _init_weight(embed_key, (cfg.vocab_size, cfg.hidden_dim), cfg.initializer_std),
360                        _EMBED_PARTITION_SPEC,
361                    )
362                    if first
363                    else None
364                ),
365                embed_norm=RMSNorm.init(cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.layer_norm_eps) if first else None,
366                embed_gated_norm=(
367                    GatedNorm.init(cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.initializer_std, key=embed_gn_key) if first else None
368                ),
369                output_proj=(
370                    jax.sharding.reshard(
371                        _init_weight(out_key, (cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.vocab_size), cfg.initializer_std),
372                        _LM_HEAD_PARTITION_SPEC,
373                    )
374                    if last
375                    else None
376                ),
377                blocks=tuple(Block.init(cfg, key=block_keys[i]) for i in range(start, end)),
378                final_norm=RMSNorm.init(cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.layer_norm_eps) if last else None,
379                final_gated_norm=GatedNorm.init(cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.initializer_std, key=final_gn_key) if last else None
 >,
380                config=cfg,
381                start_layer=start,
382                end_layer=end,
383            )
384            stage = mp_policy.cast_to_param(stage)
385            trainable, static = eqx.partition(stage, eqx.is_array)
386            for i in range(len(stage.blocks)):
387                trainable = eqx.tree_at(lambda current, index=i: current.blocks[index].mlp.router_bias, trainable, None)
388            opt_state = optimizer.init(trainable)
389            if offload_opt_state:
390                opt_state = _tree_to_memory_kind(opt_state, _HOST_MEMORY_KIND)
391            return (
392                trainable,
393                opt_state,
394                jnp.zeros((end - start, cfg.num_experts), dtype=jnp.float32),
395            ), static
396 
397        with jax.set_mesh(stage_mesh):
398            shapes, static = eqx.filter_eval_shape(initialize)
399            owns_stage = process_has_sharding(NamedSharding(stage_mesh, P()))
400            values = eqx.filter_jit(initialize)()[0] if owns_stage else shapes
401 
402        def to_mpmd(value, shape, memory_kind="device", physical_index=physical_index, owns_stage=owns_stage):
403            spec = shape.sharding.spec if isinstance(shape.sharding, NamedSharding) else P()
404            target = pp.MpmdSharding(mpmd_mesh, mesh_ids={physical_index}, spec=spec, memory_kind=memory_kind)
405            return pp.MpmdArray([value] if owns_stage else [], target, shape=shape.shape, dtype=shape.dtype)
406 
407        stage_params = jax.tree.map(to_mpmd, values[0], shapes[0])
408        # Abstract shape tracing does not retain memory kind; specify it for every process.
409        opt_memory_kind = _HOST_MEMORY_KIND if offload_opt_state else "device"
410        opt_state = jax.tree.map(partial(to_mpmd, memory_kind=opt_memory_kind), values[1], shapes[1])
411        qb = jax.tree.map(to_mpmd, values[2], shapes[2])
412        params.append(stage_params)
413        states.append(opt_state)
414        betas.append(qb)
415        static_stages.append(static)
416    return GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState(tuple(params), tuple(states), tuple(betas)), tuple(static_stages)

419def _apply_qb_betas(stage: GrugMoePipelineStage, qb_betas: jax.Array) -> GrugMoePipelineStage:
420    blocks = list(stage.blocks)
421    for index, block in enumerate(blocks):
422        new_bias = -qb_betas[index]
423        new_bias = (new_bias - jnp.mean(new_bias)).astype(block.mlp.router.dtype)
424        new_mlp = eqx.tree_at(
425            lambda mlp: mlp.router_bias,
426            block.mlp,
427            new_bias,
428            is_leaf=lambda value: value is None,
429        )
430        blocks[index] = eqx.tree_at(lambda current: current.mlp, block, new_mlp)
431    return eqx.tree_at(lambda current: current.blocks, stage, tuple(blocks))
432

437    return jaxpp, mpmd

449def _automatic_schedule(config: GrugMoePipelineConfig, schedule_name: AutomaticPipelineSchedule):

460def updated_pipeline_state(
461    state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState,
462    grads: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...],
463    qb_beta_sums: tuple[jax.Array, ...],
464    optimizer: optax.GradientTransformation,
465    mp_policy: jmp.Policy,
466    *,
467    microbatches: int,
468    qb_bias_mode: QbBiasMode = QbBiasMode.ADAPTIVE,
469    offload_opt_state: bool = False,
470) -> GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState:
471    """Update stage parameters and retain or advance the pending router biases.
472 
473    Frozen mode keeps the current pending betas, including values restored from
474    a checkpoint. Expert and router weights still receive optimizer updates.
475    """
476    grads = mp_policy.cast_to_param(grads)
477    next_params, next_opt_state = [], []
478    for params, opt_state, stage_grads in zip(state.trainable_params, state.opt_state, grads, strict=True):
479        if offload_opt_state:
480            opt_state = _tree_to_memory_kind(opt_state, "device")
481        updates, stage_opt_state = optimizer.update(stage_grads, opt_state, params)
482        if offload_opt_state:
483            stage_opt_state = _tree_to_memory_kind(stage_opt_state, _HOST_MEMORY_KIND)
484        next_params.append(mp_policy.cast_to_param(eqx.apply_updates(params, updates)))
485        next_opt_state.append(stage_opt_state)
486    if qb_bias_mode == QbBiasMode.ADAPTIVE:
487        pending_qb_betas = tuple(beta / microbatches for beta in qb_beta_sums)
488    elif qb_bias_mode == QbBiasMode.FROZEN:
489        pending_qb_betas = state.pending_qb_betas
490    else:
491        raise ValueError(f"unknown QB bias mode: {qb_bias_mode}")
492    return dataclasses.replace(
493        state,
494        trainable_params=tuple(next_params),
495        opt_state=tuple(next_opt_state),
496        pending_qb_betas=pending_qb_betas,
497    )
498

500def make_automatic_pipeline_step(
501    optimizer: optax.GradientTransformation,
502    mp_policy: jmp.Policy,
503    static_stages: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...],
504    sample_state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState,
505    sample_batches: GrugLmExample,
506    *,
507    config: GrugMoePipelineConfig,
508    mpmd_mesh,
509    schedule_name: AutomaticPipelineSchedule = AutomaticPipelineSchedule.STANDARD_1F1B,
510    logsumexp_weight: float | None = None,
511    offload_opt_state: bool = False,
512    qb_bias_mode: QbBiasMode = QbBiasMode.ADAPTIVE,
513):
514    """Build a JAXPP optimizer step using the selected pipeline schedule.
515 
516    ``static_stages`` and ``sample_state`` must come from the same automatic
517    state initializer. ``sample_batches`` must have the leading microbatch axis
518    produced by :func:`levanter.pipeline.reshape_batch_into_microbatches`.
519 
520    """
521    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
522    schedule = _automatic_schedule(config, schedule_name)
523 
524    def pipeline_step(
525        state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState,
526        batches: GrugLmExample,
527        loss_denominator: jax.Array,
528    ):
529        compute_params = mp_policy.cast_to_compute(state.trainable_params)
530 
531        def loss_fn(trainable_stages: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...], batch: GrugLmExample):
532            hidden = None
533            next_qb_betas = []
534            last_stage = None
535            for stage_index, (trainable_stage, static_stage) in enumerate(
536                zip(trainable_stages, static_stages, strict=True)
537            ):
538                stage = eqx.combine(trainable_stage, static_stage)
539                stage = _apply_qb_betas(stage, state.pending_qb_betas[stage_index])
540                if stage_index == 0:
541                    hidden = stage.embed(batch.tokens)
542                assert hidden is not None
543                hidden, router_metrics = stage.run_blocks(hidden, batch.attn_mask)
544                next_qb_betas.append(router_metrics[_QB_BETA_PER_LAYER_KEY])
545                if stage_index < config.stages - 1:
546                    hidden = pp.mark_stage_end(hidden)
547                last_stage = stage
548 
549            assert last_stage is not None
550            hidden = last_stage.finish(hidden)
551            cross_entropy_sum = last_stage.cross_entropy_loss(
552                hidden,
553                batch.tokens,
554                batch.loss_weight,
555                logsumexp_weight=logsumexp_weight,
556                reduction="sum",
557            )
558            loss = cross_entropy_sum / loss_denominator
559            loss = pp.mark_stage_end(loss)
560            return loss, tuple(next_qb_betas)
561 
562        (loss, next_qb_betas), grads = pp.treduce(
563            lambda batch: jax.value_and_grad(loss_fn, has_aux=True)(compute_params, batch),
564            batches,
565            schedule=schedule,
566            operation=((pp.Add, tuple(pp.Add for _ in range(config.stages))), pp.Add),
567        )
568        next_state = updated_pipeline_state(
569            state,
570            grads,
571            next_qb_betas,
572            optimizer,
573            mp_policy,
574            microbatches=config.microbatches,
575            qb_bias_mode=qb_bias_mode,
576            offload_opt_state=offload_opt_state,
577        )
578        return next_state, {TRAIN_LOSS_KEY: loss}
579 
580    state_shardings = partition_spec_tree(sample_state)
581    if offload_opt_state:
582 
583        def host_sharding(value):
584            if not is_pipeline_array(value):
585                return None
586            return NamedSharding(mpmd_mesh.lowering_mesh(), value.sharding.spec, memory_kind=_HOST_MEMORY_KIND)
587 
588        state_shardings = dataclasses.replace(
589            state_shardings, opt_state=jax.tree.map(host_sharding, sample_state.opt_state)
590        )
591    return pp.mpmd_jit_with_loop(
592        pipeline_step,
593        mpmd_mesh=mpmd_mesh,
594        in_specs=(state_shardings, partition_spec_tree(sample_batches), P()),
595        out_specs=(state_shardings, {TRAIN_LOSS_KEY: P()}),
596    )

599@dataclass(frozen=True)
600class ParkedPipelineState:
601    """Host-resident state with the original shardings needed to restore it."""
602 
603    state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState
604    original_shardings: tuple[jaxpp.MpmdSharding, ...]
605    local_device_bytes: int
606 
607 
608def _copy_array_to_host(array: jax.Array) -> jax.Array:
609    return jax.device_put(array, array.sharding.with_memory_kind(_HOST_MEMORY_KIND), may_alias=False)
610 
611 
612def park_pipeline_state(state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState) -> ParkedPipelineState:
613    """Free device memory for disposable warmup by parking real state on host.
614 
615    Device buffers are invalidated after their host copies complete. Callers must
616    discard aliases of the original state and restore the returned state before
617    training. Already-host-resident optimizer arrays remain intact.
618    """
619    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
620    originals, tree = jax.tree.flatten(state)
621    parked = []
622    original_shardings = []
623    device_arrays = {}
624    local_device_bytes = 0
625    for value in originals:
626        assert isinstance(value, pp.MpmdArray)
627        original = value._mpmd_sharding
628        original_shardings.append(original)
629        if original.memory_kind == _HOST_MEMORY_KIND:
630            parked.append(value)
631            continue
632        local = value.to_mpmd_local_array
633        assert local is None or isinstance(local, jax.Array), "Each process must own one pipeline stage"
634        host_arrays = []
635        if local is not None:
636            host = _copy_array_to_host(local)
637            host.block_until_ready()
638            host_arrays.append(host)
639            if id(local) not in device_arrays:
640                local_device_bytes += sum(shard.data.nbytes for shard in local.addressable_shards)
641                device_arrays[id(local)] = local
642        parked.append(
643            pp.MpmdArray(
644                host_arrays,
645                dataclasses.replace(original, memory_kind=_HOST_MEMORY_KIND),
646                shape=value.shape,
647                dtype=value.dtype,
648            )
649        )
650    # Finish every copy before deleting anything: aliases can occur across state leaves.
651    for array in device_arrays.values():
652        array.delete()
653    return ParkedPipelineState(jax.tree.unflatten(tree, parked), tuple(original_shardings), local_device_bytes)
654 
655 
656def restore_pipeline_state(parked: ParkedPipelineState) -> GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState:
657    """Restore parked local buffers and their original MPMD placement metadata."""
658    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
659    values, tree = jax.tree.flatten(parked.state)
660    restored = []
661    for value, original in zip(values, parked.original_shardings, strict=True):
662        if original.memory_kind == _HOST_MEMORY_KIND:
663            restored.append(value)
664            continue
665        local = value.to_mpmd_local_array
666        arrays = []
667        if local is not None:
668            target = local.sharding.with_memory_kind(original.memory_kind)
669            array = jax.device_put(local, target, may_alias=False)
670            array.block_until_ready()
671            arrays.append(array)
672        restored.append(pp.MpmdArray(arrays, original, shape=value.shape, dtype=value.dtype))
673    return jax.tree.unflatten(tree, restored)
674

682def prepare_automatic_mpmd_step(
683    step,
684    state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState,
685    batches: GrugLmExample,
686    loss_denominator: jax.Array,
687    mpmd_mesh,
688    *,
689    memory_threshold: int | None = None,
690) -> PreparedAutomaticMpmdStep:
691    """Compile with stage-local state and place the remaining SPMD inputs."""
692    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
693    compiled = step.compile(state, batches, loss_denominator)
694    args_shardings, kwargs_shardings = compiled.in_shardings
695    if kwargs_shardings:
696        raise ValueError("automatic pipeline step does not accept keyword arguments")
697 
698    # Compilation may share counters across stages or prune unused hyperparameters.
699    # Gather only scalar metadata so placement preserves nonzero optimizer values.
700    scalars = [value for value in jax.tree.leaves(state) if is_pipeline_array(value) and value.shape == ()]
701    scalar_report = np.zeros((len(scalars), 2), dtype=np.float64)
702    for index, value in enumerate(scalars):
703        local = value.to_mpmd_local_array if isinstance(value, pp.MpmdArray) else value
704        if local is not None:
705            scalar_report[index] = (1, float(np.asarray(local)))
706    reports = np.asarray(multihost_utils.process_allgather(scalar_report, tiled=False)).reshape(-1, len(scalars), 2)
707    owners = reports[:, :, 0].sum(axis=0)
708    if np.any(owners == 0):
709        raise ValueError("pipeline optimizer scalar has no owning process")
710    scalar_values = iter(reports[:, :, 1].sum(axis=0) / owners)
711 
712    def place_initial_scalar(value, target):
713        if not is_pipeline_array(value):
714            return value
715        if value.shape != ():
716            return value
717        scalar = np.asarray(next(scalar_values), dtype=value.dtype)
718        mesh_ids = target.mesh_ids
719        if not mesh_ids:
720            return value
721        local_arrays = []
722        for stage_index in sorted(mesh_ids):
723            sharding = NamedSharding(mpmd_mesh.unstack[stage_index], target.spec, memory_kind=target.memory_kind)
724            if process_has_sharding(sharding):
725                local_arrays.append(jax.device_put(scalar, sharding))
726        return pp.MpmdArray(
727            local_arrays,
728            target,
729            shape=(),
730            dtype=value.dtype,
731        )
732 
733    state = jax.tree.map(place_initial_scalar, state, args_shardings[0])
734    if memory_threshold is None and all(device.memory_stats() is None for device in jax.local_devices()):
735        memory_threshold = 0
736    batches, loss_denominator = pp.spmd_to_mpmd_reshard(
737        mpmd_mesh,
738        (batches, loss_denominator),
739        (args_shardings[1], args_shardings[2]),
740        threshold=memory_threshold,
741    )
742    return PreparedAutomaticMpmdStep(
743        step=compiled,
744        state=state,
745        batches=batches,
746        loss_denominator=loss_denominator,
747    )

75def _global_loss(value) -> float:
76    local = value if isinstance(value, jax.Array) else value.to_mpmd_local_array
77    report = np.array([local is not None, 0.0 if local is None else float(local)], dtype=np.float64)
78    # Finished stages must not launch GPU collectives while other stages still execute.
79    reports = np.asarray(multihost_allgather_sync(report.tolist(), timeout=_MULTIHOST_TIMEOUT)).reshape(-1, 2)
80    losses = reports[reports[:, 0] != 0, 1]
81    if not len(losses) or not np.all(np.isfinite(losses)):
82        raise FloatingPointError(f"Pipeline loss absent or nonfinite: {reports.tolist()}")
83    return float(losses[0])

93def _synchronize_local_cuda_devices(completed_steps: int) -> None:
94    """Wait on every local CUDA device without executing numerical diagnostics."""
95    runtime = importlib.import_module("cuda.bindings.runtime")
96    driver = importlib.import_module("cuda.bindings.driver")
97    devices = jax.local_devices()
98    if any(device.platform != "gpu" for device in devices):
99        raise ValueError("synchronize-devices-after-step requires CUDA devices")
100    started = time.monotonic()
101    # Preserve the calling thread's exact context, including a null/non-primary
102    # context, as well as its CUDA runtime device selection.
103    (original_context,) = _checked_cuda_result(driver.cuCtxGetCurrent(), "cuCtxGetCurrent")
104    (original_device,) = _checked_cuda_result(runtime.cudaGetDevice(), "cudaGetDevice")
105    try:
106        for device in devices:
107            ordinal = device.local_hardware_id
108            _checked_cuda_result(runtime.cudaSetDevice(ordinal), f"cudaSetDevice({ordinal})")
109            _checked_cuda_result(runtime.cudaDeviceSynchronize(), f"cudaDeviceSynchronize({ordinal})")
110    finally:
111        try:
112            _checked_cuda_result(runtime.cudaSetDevice(original_device), "cudaSetDevice(restore)")
113        finally:
114            _checked_cuda_result(driver.cuCtxSetCurrent(original_context), "cuCtxSetCurrent(restore)")
115    print(
116        "HERO_DEVICE_SYNC "
117        + json.dumps(
118            {
119                "event": "pipeline_devices_synchronized",
120                "rank": jax.process_index(),
121                "step": completed_steps,
122                "devices": len(devices),
123                "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
124            }
125        ),
126        flush=True,
127    )
128 
129 
130def _initialize_pipeline_communicators(mpmd_mesh, placements: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
131    # Create every neighboring channel before a blocking NCCL group can prevent
132    # a stage from reaching another stage's communicator initialization.
133    edges = sorted({tuple(sorted((a, b))) for a, b in itertools.pairwise(placements) if a != b})
134    for left, right in edges:
135        for source, target in zip(
136            mpmd_mesh.unstack[left].devices.flat, mpmd_mesh.unstack[right].devices.flat, strict=True
137        ):
138            if jax.process_index() not in (source.process_index, target.process_index):
139                continue
140            if env_vars.jaxpp_directional_communicators.value:
141                dime2.get_or_create_comm(dime2.UniqueDevices(source, target))
142                dime2.get_or_create_comm(dime2.UniqueDevices(target, source))
143            else:
144                dime2.get_or_create_comm(dime2.UniqueSortedDevices(source, target))
145    barrier_sync_named("hero_pipeline_communicators_initialized", timeout=_MULTIHOST_TIMEOUT)
146 
147    # NCCL establishes P2P transports on the first send/recv, even after
148    # communicator initialization. Connect both directions in a common edge
149    # order before pipeline scheduling can introduce a blocking setup cycle.
150    for left, right in edges:
151        left_mesh, right_mesh = mpmd_mesh.unstack[left], mpmd_mesh.unstack[right]
152        if any(device.process_index == jax.process_index() for device in left_mesh.devices.flat):
153            local_stage, remote_stage = left, right
154        elif any(device.process_index == jax.process_index() for device in right_mesh.devices.flat):
155            local_stage, remote_stage = right, left
156        else:
157            continue
158        local_sharding = NamedSharding(mpmd_mesh.unstack[local_stage], P())
159        remote_sharding = NamedSharding(mpmd_mesh.unstack[remote_stage], P())
160        payload = jax.make_array_from_callback(
161            (1,), local_sharding, lambda _, stage=local_stage: np.full((1,), stage, dtype=np.float32)
162        )
163        recv_buffer = jax.make_array_from_callback((1,), local_sharding, lambda _: np.zeros((1,), dtype=np.float32))
164        transfer = dime2.start_transfer([payload], [remote_sharding], [recv_buffer], [remote_sharding])
165        (received,) = transfer.done()
166        received.block_until_ready()
167        for shard in received.addressable_shards:
168            actual = np.asarray(shard.data)
169            if not np.all(actual == remote_stage):
170                raise RuntimeError(f"Pipeline channel {remote_stage}->{local_stage} received {actual}")
171    barrier_sync_named("hero_pipeline_channels_connected", timeout=_MULTIHOST_TIMEOUT)
172

174def _model_config(args: argparse.Namespace) -> GrugModelConfig:
175    if args.main_hero_recipe:
176        model_config = HERO_MODEL_CONFIG
177    elif args.full_hero:
178        model_config = dataclasses.replace(
179            HERO_MODEL_CONFIG,
180            attention_implementation="gpu_fa4_cute",
181            moe_implementation="fixed_pooled_wave_all_to_all",
182            remat_mode="recompute_all",
183            num_expert_waves=args.expert_waves,
184        )
185    else:
186        model_config = GrugModelConfig(
187            vocab_size=1024,
188            hidden_dim=256,
189            intermediate_dim=128,
190            shared_expert_intermediate_dim=128,
191            num_shared_experts=2,
192            num_experts=12 * args.expert_axis_size,
193            num_experts_per_token=2,
194            latent_dim=128,
195            num_layers=max(4, args.stages),
196            num_heads=4,
197            num_kv_heads=2,
198            local_kv_heads=2,
199            global_kv_heads=1,
200            head_dim=64,
201            max_seq_len=256,
202            sliding_window=128,
203            sconv=True,
204            rope_fused=True,
205            qb_estimator=QbEstimator.HIST,
206            attention_implementation="gpu_fa4_cute",
207            moe_implementation="fixed_pooled_wave_all_to_all",
208            num_expert_waves=args.expert_waves,
209            capacity_factor=1.15,
210            pooled_transport_capacity_factor=1.15,
211            remat_mode="recompute_all",
212        )
213    if args.attention_implementation is not None:
214        model_config = dataclasses.replace(model_config, attention_implementation=args.attention_implementation)
215    if args.moe_implementation is not None:
216        model_config = dataclasses.replace(
217            model_config, moe_implementation=args.moe_implementation, num_expert_waves=args.expert_waves
218        )
219    if args.diagnostic_layers is not None:
220        model_config = dataclasses.replace(model_config, num_layers=args.diagnostic_layers)
221    if args.sequence_length is not None:
222        model_config = dataclasses.replace(model_config, max_seq_len=args.sequence_length)
223    if args.offload_activations:
224        model_config = dataclasses.replace(model_config, remat_mode=OFFLOAD_CARRY_REMAT_MODE)
225    return model_config

228def _optimizer_and_contract(
229    args: argparse.Namespace, model_config: GrugModelConfig, batch_size: int
230) -> tuple[optax.GradientTransformation, dict[str, object]]:
231    if args.main_hero_recipe:
232        optimizer_config = dataclasses.replace(
233            MoeHeuristic().build_optimizer_config(
234                num_train_steps=args.steps,
235                batch_size=batch_size,
236                hidden_dim=model_config.hidden_dim,
237                seq_len=model_config.max_seq_len,
238            ),
239            use_syrk=all("H100" not in device.device_kind for device in jax.local_devices()),
240            gate_router_weight_decay=0.02,
241            expert_normalization=args.expert_normalization,
242        )
243        optimizer = optimizer_config.build(args.steps)
244        optimizer_contract = {"type": "muonh", **dataclasses.asdict(optimizer_config)}
245    elif args.optimizer == "muonh":
246        optimizer_config = GrugMoeMuonHConfig(
247            learning_rate=13 / 3 * 1e-4,
248            adam_lr=1e-4,
249            warmup=0,
250            lr_schedule="constant",
251            expert_normalization=args.expert_normalization,
252        )
253        optimizer = optimizer_config.build(args.steps)
254        optimizer_contract = {"type": "muonh", **dataclasses.asdict(optimizer_config)}
255    else:
256        optimizer = optax.adamw(
257            _ADAMW_LEARNING_RATE,
258            b1=_ADAMW_BETA1,
259            b2=_ADAMW_BETA2,
260            mu_dtype=_ADAMW_MOMENTUM_DTYPE,
261            weight_decay=_ADAMW_WEIGHT_DECAY,
262        )
263        optimizer_contract = {
264            "type": "adamw",
265            "learning_rate": _ADAMW_LEARNING_RATE,
266            "b1": _ADAMW_BETA1,
267            "b2": _ADAMW_BETA2,
268            "mu_dtype": np.dtype(_ADAMW_MOMENTUM_DTYPE).name,
269            "weight_decay": _ADAMW_WEIGHT_DECAY,
270        }
271    return optimizer, optimizer_contract

274def main() -> None:
275    args = parse_args()
276    model_config = _model_config(args)
277    if args.main_hero_recipe:
278        _apply_hero_ep_runtime_defaults(
279            inline_watch_enabled=False,
280            moe_implementation=model_config.moe_implementation,
281            remat_mode=model_config.remat_mode,
282            processes_per_task=args.processes_per_task,
283        )
284        if model_config.moe_implementation == RAGGED_MOE_IMPLEMENTATION:
285            verify_ragged_pjrt()
286    # Configure both caches before Iris initialization can select object storage.
287    jax.config.update("jax_compilation_cache_dir", args.compilation_cache)
288    install_cutlass_cache(PersistentKvCache.in_memory())
289    if args.coordinator_address:
290        if args.num_processes is None or args.process_id is None or args.local_device_id is None:
291            raise ValueError("External bootstrap requires num-processes, process-id, and local-device-id")
292        jax.distributed.initialize(
293            coordinator_address=args.coordinator_address,
294            num_processes=args.num_processes,
295            process_id=args.process_id,
296            local_device_ids=[args.local_device_id],
297        )
298    initialize_jax()
299    if args.run_id and jax.process_index() == 0:
300        wandb.init(
301            entity="marin-community",
302            project="marin_moe",
303            id=args.run_id,
304            name=args.run_id,
305            group="pipeline-gpu-validation",
306            resume="never",
307            config=vars(args),
308            settings=wandb.Settings(save_code=False, console="redirect"),
309        )
310    config = GrugMoePipelineConfig(
311        stages=args.stages, microbatches=args.microbatches, physical_stages=args.physical_stages
312    )
313    placements = automatic_stage_to_mpmd_indices(config, args.schedule)
314    mesh, mpmd_mesh = make_pipeline_mesh(
315        config, expert_axis_size=args.expert_axis_size, context_axis_size=args.context_axis_size, replica_axis_size=1
316    )
317    full_hero = (args.full_hero or args.main_hero_recipe) and args.diagnostic_layers is None
318    if model_config.max_seq_len % args.context_axis_size:
319        raise ValueError("sequence length must be divisible by context-axis-size")
320    batch_multiple = args.microbatches * math.prod(mesh.shape[axis] for axis in BATCH_AXES)
321    batch_size = args.batch_size if args.batch_size is not None else batch_multiple
322    if batch_size < 1 or batch_size % batch_multiple:
323        raise ValueError(f"batch-size must be a positive multiple of {batch_multiple}")
324    mp_policy = "params=float32,compute=bfloat16,output=bfloat16" if args.main_hero_recipe else _MP_POLICY
325    policy = jmp.get_policy(mp_policy)
326    flops_per_example, _ = _compute_flops(model_config=model_config)
327    peak_flops = device_flops_for_jax_device(jax.local_devices()[0].device_kind)
328    assert peak_flops is not None
329    optimizer, optimizer_contract = _optimizer_and_contract(args, model_config, batch_size)
330    checkpoint_contract = {
331        "model": dataclasses.asdict(model_config),
332        "mp_policy": mp_policy,
333        "optimizer": optimizer_contract,
334        "training_steps": args.steps,
335        "qb_bias_mode": args.qb_bias_mode,
336    }
337    _log(
338        "pipeline_init",
339        model=dataclasses.asdict(model_config),
340        batch_size=batch_size,
341        stages=args.stages,
342        physical_stages=config.mpmd_stages,
343        schedule=args.schedule,
344        placements=placements,
345        experts=args.expert_axis_size,
346        context=args.context_axis_size,
347        microbatches=args.microbatches,
348        devices=jax.device_count(),
349        optimizer=f"{args.optimizer}",
350        mp_policy=mp_policy,
351        optimizer_config=optimizer_contract,
352        offload_opt_state=args.offload_opt_state,
353        offload_activations=args.offload_activations,
354        full_hero=full_hero,
355        diagnostic_layers=args.diagnostic_layers,
356    )
357    started = time.monotonic()
358    state, static_stages = initialize_stage_local_pipeline_state(
359        model_config,
360        optimizer,
361        policy,
362        mpmd_mesh,
363        num_stages=args.stages,
364        seed=args.seed,
365        stage_to_mpmd_index=placements,
366        offload_opt_state=args.offload_opt_state,
367    )
368    _log("pipeline_initialized", elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
369    if args.offload_opt_state:
370        assert all(value.sharding.memory_kind == _HOST_MEMORY_KIND for value in jax.tree.leaves(state.opt_state))
371        _log("optimizer_state_offloaded", memory_kind=_HOST_MEMORY_KIND)
372    tokens = np.random.default_rng(args.seed).integers(
373        model_config.vocab_size, size=(batch_size, model_config.max_seq_len), dtype=np.int32
374    )
375    weights = np.ones_like(tokens, dtype=np.float32)
376    weights[:, -1] = 0
377    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
378        sequence_axis = "context" if args.context_axis_size > 1 else None
379        sharding = NamedSharding(mesh, P(BATCH_AXES, sequence_axis))
380        batch = GrugLmExample(tokens=jax.device_put(tokens, sharding), loss_weight=jax.device_put(weights, sharding))
381    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
382        denominator = jnp.sum(batch.loss_weight)
383        batches = reshape_batch_into_microbatches(batch, args.microbatches)
384    step = make_automatic_pipeline_step(
385        optimizer,
386        policy,
387        static_stages,
388        state,
389        batches,
390        config=config,
391        mpmd_mesh=mpmd_mesh,
392        schedule_name=args.schedule,
393        logsumexp_weight=1e-4 if args.main_hero_recipe else None,
394        offload_opt_state=args.offload_opt_state,
395        qb_bias_mode=args.qb_bias_mode,
396    )
397    started = time.monotonic()
398    prepared = prepare_automatic_mpmd_step(step, state, batches, denominator, mpmd_mesh)
399    _log("pipeline_compiled", elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
400    state = prepared.state
401    compiled_step = prepared.step
402    batches = prepared.batches
403    denominator = prepared.loss_denominator
404    del prepared
405    start_step = 0
406    if args.checkpoint_root:
407        state, start_step = restore_checkpoint(
408            args.checkpoint_root, state, compiled_step.in_shardings[0][0], contract=checkpoint_contract
409        )
410        if args.offload_opt_state:
411            assert all(value.sharding.memory_kind == _HOST_MEMORY_KIND for value in jax.tree.leaves(state.opt_state))
412        _log("pipeline_checkpoint_restored", step=start_step, checkpoint_root=args.checkpoint_root)
413    # The compiled function takes state as an argument; no real arrays are
414    # donated to disposable warmup. Delete old aliases before parking buffers.
415    del step
416    parked = park_pipeline_state(state) if args.park_state_during_warmup else None
417    if parked is not None:
418        del state
419        _log("pipeline_state_parked", local_device_bytes=parked.local_device_bytes)
420    started = time.monotonic()
421    task_count = precompile_automatic_mpmd_step(compiled_step)
422    if parked is not None:
423        state = restore_pipeline_state(parked)
424        del parked
425        _log("pipeline_state_restored")
426    barrier_sync_named("hero_pipeline_tasks_warmed", timeout=_MULTIHOST_TIMEOUT)
427    _log("pipeline_tasks_warmed", task_count=task_count, elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
428    started = time.monotonic()
429    _initialize_pipeline_communicators(mpmd_mesh, placements)
430    _log("pipeline_communicators_initialized", elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
431    last_step = args.stop_after_step or args.steps
432    for completed_steps in range(start_step + 1, last_step + 1):
433        started = time.monotonic()
434        state, metrics = compiled_step(state, batches, denominator)
435        jax.block_until_ready((state, metrics))
436        if args.synchronize_devices_after_step:
437            _synchronize_local_cuda_devices(completed_steps)
438        if args.offload_opt_state:
439            assert all(value.sharding.memory_kind == _HOST_MEMORY_KIND for value in jax.tree.leaves(state.opt_state))
440        elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
441        loss = _global_loss(metrics[TRAIN_LOSS_KEY])
442        mfu_percent = 100 * batch_size * flops_per_example / (elapsed * jax.device_count() * peak_flops)
443        _log(
444            "pipeline_step",
445            step=completed_steps,
446            loss=loss,
447            elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
448            tokens_per_second=batch_size * model_config.max_seq_len / elapsed,
449            mfu_percent=mfu_percent,
450        )
451        if args.run_id and jax.process_index() == 0:
452            wandb.log(
453                {TRAIN_LOSS_KEY: loss, "step_seconds": elapsed, "throughput/mfu": mfu_percent}, step=completed_steps
454            )
455        if args.checkpoint_root and args.checkpoint_every_steps:
456            if completed_steps % args.checkpoint_every_steps == 0 or completed_steps == last_step:
457                path = save_checkpoint(args.checkpoint_root, state, step=completed_steps, contract=checkpoint_contract)
458                _log("pipeline_checkpoint_saved", step=completed_steps, path=path)
459    barrier_sync_named("hero_pipeline_smoke_complete", timeout=_MULTIHOST_TIMEOUT)
460    _log("pipeline_complete", steps=last_step, full_hero=full_hero)
461    if args.run_id and jax.process_index() == 0:
462        wandb.finish()
463 
464 
465if __name__ == "__main__":
466    main()

34def _tiny_hero(qb_estimator: QbEstimator, context_axis_size: int = 1) -> tuple[Mesh, Transformer]:
35    config = GrugModelConfig(
36        vocab_size=16,
37        hidden_dim=8,
38        intermediate_dim=4,
39        latent_dim=4,
40        shared_expert_intermediate_dim=4,
41        num_shared_experts=2,
42        num_experts=4,
43        num_experts_per_token=1,
44        num_layers=5,
45        num_heads=2,
46        num_kv_heads=2,
47        local_kv_heads=2,
48        global_kv_heads=1,
49        head_dim=4,
50        max_seq_len=6,
51        sliding_window=2,
52        global_every=3,
53        sconv=True,
54        sconv_kernel=3,
55        qb_estimator=qb_estimator,
56        # Keep this fixture's margins away from bin edges, where scan/stage
57        # roundoff can produce a full-bin quantile jump.
58        qb_hist_bins=33,
59        attention_implementation="reference",
60        moe_implementation="scatter",
61        initializer_std=0.2,
62    )
63    mesh = Mesh(
64        np.asarray(jax.devices()[:context_axis_size]).reshape(1, 1, context_axis_size, 1, 1),
65        ("replica_dcn", "data", "context", "expert", "model"),
66        axis_types=(AxisType.Explicit,) * 5,
67    )
68    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
69        model = Transformer.init(config, key=jax.random.key(42))
70        # Nonzero delayed convolution taps exercise packed-document boundaries.
71        model = eqx.tree_at(
72            lambda current: (
73                current.stacked_blocks.stacked.attn.sconv_k.weight,
74                current.stacked_blocks.stacked.sconv_attn.weight,
75                current.stacked_blocks.stacked.sconv_mlp.weight,
76            ),
77            model,
78            replace_fn=lambda weights: weights.at[:, 1:, :].set(0.1),
79        )
80    return mesh, model

83def _packed_batch() -> GrugLmExample:
84    segments = jnp.array([[0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1], [0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1]], dtype=jnp.int32)
85    return GrugLmExample(
86        tokens=jnp.array([[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]], dtype=jnp.int32),
87        loss_weight=jnp.array([[1.0, 0.5, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0], [1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5, 0.0]]),
88        attn_mask=AttentionMask.causal().with_segment_ids(segments),
89    )

92@pytest.mark.parametrize("qb_bias_mode", [QbBiasMode.ADAPTIVE, QbBiasMode.FROZEN])
93def test_pipeline_update_trains_weights_with_adaptive_or_frozen_router_bias(qb_bias_mode):
94    mesh, model = _tiny_hero(QbEstimator.HIST)
95    optimizer = optax.sgd(0.1, momentum=0.5)
96    policy = jmp.get_policy("params=float32,compute=bfloat16,output=bfloat16")
97    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
98        state = _pipeline_state(model, optimizer, (2, 3))
99        betas = state.pending_qb_betas
100        grads = eqx.filter_grad(lambda values: sum(jnp.sum(value**2) for value in jax.tree.leaves(values)))(
101            state.trainable_params
102        )
103        measured_beta_sums = tuple(jnp.full_like(beta, 12.0) for beta in betas)
104        updated = updated_pipeline_state(
105            state, grads, measured_beta_sums, optimizer, policy, microbatches=4, qb_bias_mode=qb_bias_mode
106        )
107        second = updated_pipeline_state(
108            updated, grads, measured_beta_sums, optimizer, policy, microbatches=4, qb_bias_mode=qb_bias_mode
109        )
110 
111    for original, actual, second_actual in zip(
112        jax.tree.leaves(state.trainable_params),
113        jax.tree.leaves(updated.trainable_params),
114        jax.tree.leaves(second.trainable_params),
115        strict=True,
116    ):
117        # d(sum(p**2))/dp = 2p. Momentum carries the first gradient into step two.
118        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, 0.8 * original, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
119        np.testing.assert_allclose(second_actual, 0.5 * original, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
120        assert actual.dtype == jnp.float32
121    for original, actual, second_actual in zip(betas, updated.pending_qb_betas, second.pending_qb_betas, strict=True):
122        expected = original if qb_bias_mode == QbBiasMode.FROZEN else jnp.full_like(original, 3.0)
123        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
124        np.testing.assert_array_equal(second_actual, expected)

127@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [jnp.float32, jnp.bfloat16])
128def test_pipeline_embedding_recompute_preserves_values_and_gradients(dtype):
129    mesh, model = _tiny_hero(QbEstimator.HIST)
130    tokens = _packed_batch().tokens
131    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
132        stage = split_transformer(model, 2, layer_counts=(2, 3))[0]
133        stage = jax.tree.map(lambda x: x.astype(dtype) if eqx.is_inexact_array(x) else x, stage)
134 
135        def reference(params):
136            hidden = params.token_embed[tokens]
137            return params.embed_gated_norm(params.embed_norm(hidden))
138 
139        expected, reference_pullback = jax.vjp(reference, stage)
140        actual, pullback = jax.vjp(lambda params: params.embed(tokens), stage)
141        cotangent = jax.random.normal(jax.random.key(73), actual.shape, dtype=dtype)
142        (expected_grads,) = reference_pullback(jax.device_put(cotangent, expected.sharding))
143        (actual_grads,) = pullback(jax.device_put(cotangent, actual.sharding))
144 
145    np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
146    for actual_grad, expected_grad in zip(jax.tree.leaves(actual_grads), jax.tree.leaves(expected_grads), strict=True):
147        np.testing.assert_allclose(
148            actual_grad.astype(jnp.float32), expected_grad.astype(jnp.float32), rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5
149        )

175# Compiling both gradient paths can exceed the default minute on shared CI CPUs.
176@pytest.mark.timeout(180)
177@pytest.mark.parametrize("remat_mode", ["recompute_all", "offload_carry"])
178def test_hero_pipeline_loss_and_gradients_match_unsplit_model(remat_mode):
179    mesh, model = _tiny_hero(QbEstimator.HIST)
180    batch = _packed_batch()
181 
182    def ordinary_loss(params):
183        return params.next_token_loss(batch.tokens, batch.loss_weight, mask=batch.attn_mask, logsumexp_weight=0.01)
184 
185    def pipeline_loss(params):
186        params = dataclasses.replace(params, config=dataclasses.replace(params.config, remat_mode=remat_mode))
187        stages = split_transformer(params, 2, layer_counts=(2, 3))
188        hidden = stages[0].embed(batch.tokens)
189        for stage in stages:
190            hidden, _ = stage.run_blocks(hidden, batch.attn_mask)
191        return stages[-1].cross_entropy_loss(
192            stages[-1].finish(hidden), batch.tokens, batch.loss_weight, logsumexp_weight=0.01
193        )
194 
195    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
196        expected_loss, expected_grads = jax.value_and_grad(ordinary_loss)(model)
197        actual_loss, pullback = jax.vjp(pipeline_loss, model)
198        if remat_mode == "offload_carry":
199            host_residuals = [
200                value
201                for value in jax.tree.leaves(pullback)
202                if isinstance(value, jax.Array) and value.sharding.memory_kind == "pinned_host"
203            ]
204            # Every layer input, including the stage boundary, must live on host
205            # between forward and backward rather than merely carry a remat name.
206            assert len(host_residuals) == model.config.num_layers
207            assert all(value.shape == (*batch.tokens.shape, model.config.hidden_dim) for value in host_residuals)
208        (actual_grads,) = pullback(jnp.ones_like(actual_loss))
209 
210    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual_loss, expected_loss, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
211    for actual, expected in zip(jax.tree.leaves(actual_grads), jax.tree.leaves(expected_grads), strict=True):
212        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)

258def test_parked_host_copy_survives_device_alias_deletion_and_restores_bits():
259    mesh = Mesh(np.asarray(jax.devices()[:1]), ("expert",), axis_types=(AxisType.Explicit,))

265    parked.block_until_ready()

267    original.delete()
268    assert alias.is_deleted()
269    np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.asarray(parked).view(np.uint32), values.view(np.uint32))
270    restored = jax.device_put(parked, sharding, may_alias=False)
271    restored.block_until_ready()
272    parked.delete()
273    assert restored.sharding == sharding
274    np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.asarray(restored).view(np.uint32), values.view(np.uint32))

277def _pipeline_state(model, optimizer, layer_counts):
278    stages = split_transformer(model, len(layer_counts), layer_counts=layer_counts)
279    trainable = []
280    for stage in stages:
281        params, _ = eqx.partition(stage, eqx.is_array)
282        for index in range(len(stage.blocks)):
283            params = eqx.tree_at(lambda current, index=index: current.blocks[index].mlp.router_bias, params, None)
284        trainable.append(params)
285    return GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState(
286        trainable_params=tuple(trainable),
287        opt_state=tuple(optimizer.init(params) for params in trainable),
288        pending_qb_betas=tuple(
289            jnp.arange(len(stage.blocks) * model.config.num_experts, dtype=jnp.float32).reshape(
290                len(stage.blocks), model.config.num_experts
291            )
292            + 10 * stage.start_layer
293            for stage in stages
294        ),
295    )

298@pytest.mark.parametrize("optimizer_name", ["adamw", "muonh"])
299def test_hero_checkpoint_restores_complete_state_with_different_stage_split(tmp_path, optimizer_name):
300    mesh, model = _tiny_hero(QbEstimator.HIST)
301    optimizer = (
302        optax.adamw(1e-4)
303        if optimizer_name == "adamw"
304        else GrugMoeMuonHConfig(learning_rate=1e-4, adam_lr=1e-4, warmup=0).build(3)
305    )
306 
307    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
308        state = _pipeline_state(model, optimizer, (2, 3))
309        if optimizer_name == "adamw":
310            gradients = jax.tree.map(jnp.ones_like, state.trainable_params)
311            updates = tuple(
312                optimizer.update(gradient, opt_state, params)
313                for gradient, opt_state, params in zip(gradients, state.opt_state, state.trainable_params, strict=True)
314            )
315            state = dataclasses.replace(
316                state,
317                trainable_params=tuple(
318                    optax.apply_updates(params, update)
319                    for params, (update, _) in zip(state.trainable_params, updates, strict=True)
320                ),
321                opt_state=tuple(next_state for _, next_state in updates),
322            )
323        else:
324            # MuonH's sharded Newton-Schulz update is GPU-only; give each state
325            # array a distinct nonzero value to test its nested checkpoint tree.
326            state = dataclasses.replace(
327                state,
328                opt_state=jax.tree.map(lambda value: value + jnp.ones_like(value), state.opt_state),
329            )
330        canonical = checkpoint_state(state)
331        root = str(tmp_path)
332        path = save_checkpoint(root, state, step=1, contract={"model": "tiny-hero", "optimizer": optimizer_name})
333        loaded = load_checkpoint(jax.tree.map(jnp.zeros_like, canonical), path)
334        assert jax.tree.structure(loaded) == jax.tree.structure(canonical)
335        for actual, expected in zip(jax.tree.leaves(loaded), jax.tree.leaves(canonical), strict=True):
336            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
337 
338        destination = _pipeline_state(model, optimizer, (1, 1, 1, 1, 1))
339        destination = jax.tree.map(jnp.zeros_like, destination)
340        shardings = jax.tree.map(lambda value: value.sharding, destination)
341        restored, completed = restore_checkpoint(
342            root, destination, shardings, contract={"model": "tiny-hero", "optimizer": optimizer_name}
343        )
344        assert completed == 1
345        restored_canonical = checkpoint_state(restored)
346        assert jax.tree.structure(restored_canonical) == jax.tree.structure(canonical)
347        for actual, expected in zip(jax.tree.leaves(restored_canonical), jax.tree.leaves(canonical), strict=True):
348            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)

351@eqx.filter_jit
352def _serial_training_step(state, batch, optimizer):
353    # Exercise real Hero gradients and delayed QB updates without CUDA/JAXPP.
354    def loss_fn(params):
355        hidden = params[0].embed(batch.tokens)
356        next_betas = []
357        for stage, betas in zip(params, state.pending_qb_betas, strict=True):
358            stage = _apply_qb_betas(stage, betas)
359            hidden, metrics = stage.run_blocks(hidden, batch.attn_mask)
360            next_betas.append(metrics["qb_beta_per_layer"])
361        loss = stage.cross_entropy_loss(stage.finish(hidden), batch.tokens, batch.loss_weight, logsumexp_weight=0.01)
362        return loss, tuple(next_betas)
363 
364    (loss, next_betas), grads = jax.value_and_grad(loss_fn, has_aux=True)(state.trainable_params)
365    next_state = updated_pipeline_state(
366        state,
367        grads,
368        next_betas,
369        optimizer,
370        jmp.get_policy("params=float32,compute=float32,output=float32"),
371        microbatches=1,
372    )
373    return next_state, loss
374

376@pytest.mark.timeout(180)
377@pytest.mark.parametrize("restored_layer_counts", [(2, 3), (1, 1, 1, 1, 1)])
378def test_checkpoint_next_two_training_steps_match_uninterrupted_run(tmp_path, restored_layer_counts):
379    mesh, model = _tiny_hero(QbEstimator.HIST)
380    # Changing learning rates expose a reset schedule counter as well as Adam's
381    # bias-correction counter. Every restart uses the full four-step schedule.
382    optimizer = optax.adamw(optax.linear_schedule(1e-3, 1e-4, transition_steps=4))
383    contract = {"model": "tiny-hero", "optimizer": "adamw", "training_steps": 4}
384    batch = _packed_batch()
385 
386    def advance(state, completed_step):
387        next_batch = dataclasses.replace(batch, tokens=(batch.tokens + completed_step) % model.config.vocab_size)
388        return _serial_training_step(state, next_batch, optimizer)
389 
390    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
391        uninterrupted = _pipeline_state(model, optimizer, (2, 3))
392        for completed_step in (1, 2):
393            uninterrupted, _ = advance(uninterrupted, completed_step)
394        save_checkpoint(str(tmp_path), uninterrupted, step=2, contract=contract)
395 
396        destination = _pipeline_state(model, optimizer, restored_layer_counts)
397        shardings = jax.tree.map(lambda value: value.sharding, destination)
398        resumed, completed = restore_checkpoint(str(tmp_path), destination, shardings, contract=contract)
399        assert completed == 2
400 
401        resumed_steps = []
402        for completed_step in range(completed + 1, contract["training_steps"] + 1):
403            uninterrupted, expected_loss = advance(uninterrupted, completed_step)
404            resumed, actual_loss = advance(resumed, completed_step)
405            resumed_steps.append(completed_step)
406            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual_loss, expected_loss)
407            expected = checkpoint_state(uninterrupted)
408            actual = checkpoint_state(resumed)
409            for actual_value, expected_value in zip(jax.tree.leaves(actual), jax.tree.leaves(expected), strict=True):
410                np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual_value, expected_value)
411        assert resumed_steps == [3, 4]

4"""grug-base trial run, authored as a lazy artifact.

6The run is a function that returns a typed :class:`Checkpoint` handle addressed by an

79@dataclass(frozen=True)
80class GrugBaseLaunchConfig:
81    """Last-mile run config for the base grug template.
82 
83    Keep this as the main entry point for day-to-day edits (model/data/optimizer/trainer/eval knobs).
84 
85    The trainer and eval knobs are flat scalars rather than nested
86    ``GrugTrainerConfig`` / ``GrugEvalConfig`` objects: those carry
87    ``jax.sharding.PartitionSpec`` batch-sharding defaults, which the artifact
88    fingerprint cannot serialize. ``build_grug_run_config`` reconstitutes them (with
89    their default pspecs) at run time, keeping the sharding plumbing out of the
90    artifact's identity.
91    """

93    model: GrugModelConfig
94    data: LmDataConfig
95    output_path: str
96    run_id: str
97    resources: ResourceConfig
98    steps: int
99    batch_size: int
100    seed: int

102    tracker: TrackerConfig
103    optimizer: OptimizerConfig
104    z_loss_weight: float = 1e-4
105    ema_beta: float | None = None  # EMA coefficient for eval/checkpoint model; None disables EMA.
106    log_every: int = 1
107    loss_implementation: str | tuple[str, ...] | None = None  # cross-entropy kernel; None uses the trainer default.
108    eval_batch_size: int | None = 512  # None disables perplexity eval.
109    steps_per_eval: int = 1000
110    max_eval_batches: int = 8
111    eval_current: bool = True
112    eval_ema: bool = False
113

115def _resolve_run_id(default_run_id: str) -> str:
