130def build_grug_run_config(launch: GrugBaseLaunchConfig) -> GrugRunConfig:
131    """Map launch knobs onto the trainer's full ``GrugRunConfig``.
132 
133    The checkpointer's ``base_path`` and ``temporary_base_path`` derive from
134    ``launch.output_path``, so a run resolves its checkpoint locations under the
135    region its output path lives in.
136    """
137    output_path = launch.output_path
138    trainer = TrainerConfig(
139        id=launch.run_id,
140        seed=launch.seed,
141        train_batch_size=launch.batch_size,
142        num_train_steps=launch.steps,
143        profiler=ProfilerConfig(enabled=False, start_step=5, num_steps=100, perfetto_link=False),
144        mp=jmp.get_policy(launch.mp),
145        tracker=_resolve_tracker(launch.tracker, launch.run_id),
146        use_explicit_mesh_axes=True,
147        require_accelerator=True,
148        allow_nondivisible_batch_size=False,
149        checkpointer=resolve_checkpointer_output_path(
150            CheckpointerConfig(save_interval=timedelta(minutes=10), keep=None),
151            output_path,
152        ),
153    )
154 
155    grug_trainer = GrugTrainerConfig(
156        trainer=trainer,
157        z_loss_weight=launch.z_loss_weight,
158        ema_beta=launch.ema_beta,
159        log_every=launch.log_every,
160        loss_implementation=launch.loss_implementation,
161    )
162 
163    eval_config = (
164        GrugEvalConfig(
165            eval_batch_size=launch.eval_batch_size,
166            steps_per_eval=launch.steps_per_eval,
167            max_eval_batches=launch.max_eval_batches,
168            eval_current=launch.eval_current,
169            eval_ema=launch.eval_ema,
170        )
171        if launch.eval_batch_size is not None
172        else None
173    )
174 
175    return GrugRunConfig(
176        model=launch.model,
177        data=launch.data,
178        resources=launch.resources,
179        output_path=output_path,
180        optimizer=launch.optimizer,
181        trainer=grug_trainer,
182        eval=eval_config,
183    )

186def run_grug_base_trial(config: GrugBaseLaunchConfig) -> None:

195def grug_base_trial(*, version: str | None = None) -> ArtifactStep[LevanterCheckpoint]:
196    """The base grug trial on the Nemotron mix as a lazy checkpoint.
197 
198    Every component is a :class:`Dataset` handle, so the whole graph lowers via
199    :func:`~marin.execution.lazy.lower`. The paloma/uncheatable suites are validation
200    (weight 0).
201    """
202    name = "grug/base-trial"
203    version = resolve_version(name, version)
204    nem = nemotron_datasets(tokenizer=llama3_tokenizer)
205    train = {nem[split]: weight for split, weight in _NEMOTRON_WEIGHTS.items()}
206    train[starcoder_dataset(tokenizer=llama3_tokenizer)] = _STARCODER_WEIGHT
207    train[proofpile_dataset(tokenizer=llama3_tokenizer)] = _PROOFPILE_WEIGHT
208    validation = [
209        *paloma_datasets(tokenizer=llama3_tokenizer).values(),
210        *uncheatable_datasets(tokenizer=llama3_tokenizer).values(),
211    ]
212 
213    run_id = _resolve_run_id("grug-base-trial")
214 
215    def build_config(ctx: StepContext) -> GrugBaseLaunchConfig:
216        return GrugBaseLaunchConfig(
217            model=GRUG_130M_MODEL,
218            data=mixture(ctx, train, validation=validation),
219            output_path=ctx.output_path,
220            run_id=run_id,
221            resources=ctx.runtime_arg("train_resources"),
222            steps=2_000,
223            batch_size=512,
224            seed=0,
225            mp="params=float32,compute=bfloat16,output=bfloat16",
226            tracker=WandbConfig(
227                project="marin",
228                tags=["grug", "template"],
229                group="grug-base-trial",
230                name=None,  # filled from run_id in _resolve_tracker
231                replicate_path=ctx.output_path,
232            ),
233            optimizer=AdamConfig(
234                learning_rate=3e-3,
235                weight_decay=0.1,
236                lr_schedule="cosine",
237                decay=0.2,
238                min_lr_ratio=0.1,
239                warmup=1000,
240            ),
241            z_loss_weight=1e-4,
242            ema_beta=None,
243            log_every=1,
244            eval_batch_size=512,
245            steps_per_eval=1000,
246            max_eval_batches=8,
247            eval_current=True,
248            eval_ema=False,
249        )
250 
251    return ArtifactStep(
252        name=user_namespaced_name(name, version),
253        version=version,
254        artifact_type=LevanterCheckpoint,
255        run=run_grug_base_trial,
256        build_config=build_config,
257        deps=(*train, *validation),
258        runtime_args={"train_resources": _TRAIN_RESOURCES},
259    )
260 
261 
262if __name__ == "__main__":
263    experiment_main(grug_base_trial)()

43    def __post_init__(self) -> None:

45        if self.num_heads % self.num_kv_heads != 0:
46            raise ValueError("num_heads must be divisible by num_kv_heads for grouped-query attention")
47        if self.vocab_size <= 0:

63class CausalSelfAttention(eqx.Module):
64    w_q: jax.Array
65    w_k: jax.Array
66    w_v: jax.Array
67    w_o: jax.Array
68    cfg: GrugModelConfig = eqx.field(static=True)
69 
70    @staticmethod
71    def init(cfg: GrugModelConfig, *, key: PRNGKeyArray) -> "CausalSelfAttention":
72        k_q, k_k, k_v, k_o = random.split(key, 4)
73        d_model, n_heads, n_kv_heads, head_dim = cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.num_heads, cfg.num_kv_heads, cfg.inferred_head_dim
74        return CausalSelfAttention(
75            w_q=reshard(_init_weight(k_q, (d_model, n_heads * head_dim), cfg.initializer_std), P("data", "model")),
76            w_k=reshard(_init_weight(k_k, (d_model, n_kv_heads * head_dim), cfg.initializer_std), P("data", "model")),
77            w_v=reshard(_init_weight(k_v, (d_model, n_kv_heads * head_dim), cfg.initializer_std), P("data", "model")),
78            w_o=reshard(_init_weight(k_o, (n_heads * head_dim, d_model), cfg.initializer_std), P("model", "data")),
79            cfg=cfg,
80        )
81 
82    @trace_grads
83    @named_call
84    def __call__(self, x: Float[Array, "B S D"], mask: AttentionMask | jax.Array) -> Float[Array, "B S D"]:
85        head_dim = self.cfg.inferred_head_dim
86        seq_len = x.shape[1]
87 
88        q = rearrange(jnp.einsum("bsh,hd->bsd", x, self.w_q), "... (n d) -> ... n d", d=head_dim)
89        k = rearrange(jnp.einsum("bsh,hd->bsd", x, self.w_k), "... (m d) -> ... m d", d=head_dim)
90        v = rearrange(jnp.einsum("bsh,hd->bsd", x, self.w_v), "... (m d) -> ... m d", d=head_dim)
91        q, k = apply_rotary_embedding(q, k, seq_len=seq_len, head_dim=head_dim, rope=self.cfg.rope)
92        attn_out = attention(q, k, v, mask)
93        attn_out = rearrange(attn_out, "... n d -> ... (n d)")
94        return jnp.einsum("bsh,hd->bsd", attn_out, self.w_o, out_sharding=Pbatch)
95

97class MLP(eqx.Module):
98    mlp_up: jax.Array
99    mlp_down: jax.Array
100 
101    @staticmethod
102    def init(cfg: GrugModelConfig, *, key: PRNGKeyArray) -> "MLP":
103        k_up, k_down = random.split(key, 2)
104        d_model, d_ff = cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.intermediate_dim
105        return MLP(
106            mlp_up=reshard(_init_weight(k_up, (d_model, d_ff), cfg.initializer_std), P("data", "model")),
107            mlp_down=reshard(_init_weight(k_down, (d_ff, d_model), cfg.initializer_std), P("model", "data")),
108        )
109 
110    @trace_grads
111    @named_call
112    def __call__(self, x: Float[Array, "B S D"]) -> Float[Array, "B S D"]:
113        up = jnp.einsum("bsh,hm->bsm", x, self.mlp_up)
114        activated = jax.nn.relu(up)
115        return jnp.einsum("bsm,mh->bsh", activated, self.mlp_down, out_sharding=Pbatch)

118class RMSNorm(eqx.Module):
119    weight: jax.Array
120    eps: float = eqx.field(static=True)
121 
122    @staticmethod
123    def init(dim: int, eps: float) -> "RMSNorm":
124        return RMSNorm(weight=jnp.ones((dim,), dtype=jnp.float32), eps=eps)
125 
126    @named_call
127    def __call__(self, x: Float[Array, "... D"]) -> Float[Array, "... D"]:
128        weight = unshard(self.weight)
129        dtype = x.dtype
130        x = x.astype(jnp.float32)
131        variance = jnp.mean(jnp.square(x), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
132        normed = x * jax.lax.rsqrt(variance + self.eps)
133        return (normed * weight).astype(dtype)
134

136class Block(eqx.Module):
137    rms_attn: RMSNorm
138    attn: CausalSelfAttention
139    rms_mlp: RMSNorm
140    mlp: MLP
141 
142    @staticmethod
143    def init(cfg: GrugModelConfig, *, key: PRNGKeyArray) -> "Block":
144        attn_key, mlp_key = random.split(key, 2)
145        return Block(
146            rms_attn=RMSNorm.init(cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.layer_norm_eps),
147            attn=CausalSelfAttention.init(cfg, key=attn_key),
148            rms_mlp=RMSNorm.init(cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.layer_norm_eps),
149            mlp=MLP.init(cfg, key=mlp_key),
150        )
151 
152    @named_call
153    def __call__(self, x: Float[Array, "B S D"], mask: AttentionMask | jax.Array) -> Float[Array, "B S D"]:
154        x = trace_backward_activation(x, "resid_in")
155        x = x + self.attn(self.rms_attn(x), mask)
156        x = trace_backward_activation(x, "resid_post_attn")
157        x = x + self.mlp(self.rms_mlp(x))
158        return trace_backward_activation(x, "resid_out")

161class Transformer(eqx.Module):

164    blocks: tuple[Block, ...]
165    final_norm: RMSNorm
166    config: GrugModelConfig = eqx.field(static=True)
167 
168    @staticmethod
169    def init(cfg: GrugModelConfig, *, key: PRNGKeyArray) -> "Transformer":
170        embed_key, out_key, *block_keys = random.split(key, cfg.num_layers + 2)
171        token_embed = reshard(
172            _init_weight(embed_key, (cfg.vocab_size, cfg.hidden_dim), cfg.initializer_std), Pembed_vocab
173        )
174        output_proj = reshard(_init_weight(out_key, (cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.vocab_size), cfg.initializer_std), Plm_head)
175        blocks = tuple(Block.init(cfg, key=layer_key) for layer_key in block_keys)
176        final_norm = RMSNorm.init(cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.layer_norm_eps)
177        return Transformer(
178            token_embed=token_embed,
179            output_proj=output_proj,
180            blocks=blocks,
181            final_norm=final_norm,
182            config=cfg,
183        )
184 
185    @named_call
186    def __call__(
187        self,
188        token_ids: Int[Array, "B S"],
189        mask: AttentionMask | jax.Array | None = None,
190    ) -> Float[Array, "B S D"]:
191        if mask is None:
192            mask = AttentionMask.causal()
193 
194        with jax.named_scope("token_embed"):
195            hidden = self.token_embed.at[token_ids].get(out_sharding=Pbatch)
196            hidden = log_backward_activation(hidden)
197        for i, block in enumerate(self.blocks):
198            with jax.named_scope(f"block_{i}"):
199                block_fn = block if is_backward_flow_active() else eqx.filter_checkpoint(block)
200                hidden = block_fn(hidden, mask)
201        with jax.named_scope("final_norm"):
202            hidden = self.final_norm(hidden)
203            return log_backward_activation(hidden)
204 
205    @named_call
206    def logits(
207        self,
208        token_ids: Int[Array, "B S"],
209        mask: AttentionMask | jax.Array | None = None,
210    ) -> Float[Array, "B S V"]:
211        hidden = self(token_ids, mask=mask)
212        return jnp.einsum("bsh,hd->bsd", hidden, self.output_proj, out_sharding=Plogits)
213 
214    def next_token_loss(
215        self,
216        token_ids: Int[Array, "B S"],
217        loss_weight: Float[Array, "B S"],
218        *,
219        mask: AttentionMask | jax.Array | None = None,
220        reduction: str = "mean",
221        logsumexp_weight: float | None = None,
222        loss_dtype: jnp.dtype = jnp.float32,
223        loss_implementation: str | tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
224    ) -> jax.Array:
225        """Compute next-token cross-entropy loss for a batch."""
226        hidden = self(token_ids, mask=mask)
227        labels = jnp.pad(token_ids[:, 1:], ((0, 0), (0, 1))).astype(jnp.int32)
228        loss_weight = loss_weight.astype(loss_dtype)
229 
230        return fused_linear_softmax_cross_entropy_loss(
231            hidden,
232            self.output_proj,
233            labels,
234            weight=loss_weight,
235            reduction=reduction,
236            logsumexp_weight=logsumexp_weight,
237            dtype=loss_dtype,
238            implementation=loss_implementation,
239        )
240 
241 
242def _init_weight(key: PRNGKeyArray, shape: tuple[int, ...], std: float) -> Float[Array, "..."]:
243    return std * random.truncated_normal(key, -3, 3, shape)
244

246def debug_mesh_and_token_pspec(num_devices: int, model_axis_size: int = 1) -> tuple[jax.sharding.AbstractMesh, P]:
247    """Return a small abstract mesh and token sharding for lowering contract tests."""
248    if num_devices <= 0:
249        raise ValueError(f"num_devices must be positive, got {num_devices}")
250    if model_axis_size <= 0:
251        raise ValueError(f"model_axis_size must be positive, got {model_axis_size}")
252    if num_devices % model_axis_size != 0:
253        raise ValueError(f"num_devices ({num_devices}) must be divisible by model_axis_size ({model_axis_size})")
254    data_axis_size = num_devices // model_axis_size
255    mesh = jax.sharding.AbstractMesh(
256        axis_sizes=(1, data_axis_size, model_axis_size),
257        axis_names=("replica_dcn", "data", "model"),
258        axis_types=(
259            jax.sharding.AxisType.Explicit,
260            jax.sharding.AxisType.Explicit,
261            jax.sharding.AxisType.Explicit,
262        ),
263    )
264    return mesh, P(("replica_dcn", "data"), None)

155def build_tagged_evaluator(
156    *,
157    data_config: LmDataConfig,
158    max_seq_len: int,
159    mesh: Mesh,
160    eval_cfg: GrugEvalConfig,
161) -> TaggedEvaluator[LmExample | GrugLmExample, Transformer] | None:
162    pos = Axis("position", max_seq_len)
163    tagged_eval_sets = data_config.tagged_eval_sets(pos)
164    if len(tagged_eval_sets) == 0:
165        logger.warning("No evaluation datasets provided.")
166        return None
167 
168    max_examples_per_dataset = None
169    if eval_cfg.max_eval_batches is not None:
170        max_examples_per_dataset = eval_cfg.max_eval_batches * eval_cfg.eval_batch_size
171 
172    tokenizer = data_config.the_tokenizer if eval_cfg.compute_bpb else None
173    batch_axis_resource = eval_cfg.eval_batch_pspec[0]
174    eval_axis_mapping = {"batch": batch_axis_resource}
175    eval_batch = Axis("batch", eval_cfg.eval_batch_size)
176    eval_array_sharding = NamedSharding(mesh, P(batch_axis_resource, None))
177 
178    def eval_loss_fn(model: Transformer, batch: LmExample | GrugLmExample) -> tuple[jax.Array, jax.Array, jax.Array]:
179        if isinstance(batch, LmExample):
180            batch = grug_lm_example_from_named(batch)
181        per_pos_loss = model.next_token_loss(
182            batch.tokens,
183            batch.loss_weight,
184            mask=batch.attn_mask,
185            reduction="none",
186            logsumexp_weight=None,
187        )
188        per_pos_loss = jax.sharding.reshard(per_pos_loss, eval_array_sharding)
189        per_pos_weight = jax.sharding.reshard(batch.loss_weight, eval_array_sharding)
190        per_pos_token_id = jnp.pad(batch.tokens[:, 1:], ((0, 0), (0, 1)))
191        return per_pos_loss, per_pos_weight, per_pos_token_id
192 
193    return TaggedEvaluator(
194        EvalBatch=eval_batch,
195        tagged_eval_sets=tagged_eval_sets,
196        loss_fn=eval_loss_fn,
197        tokenizer=tokenizer,
198        device_mesh=mesh,
199        axis_mapping=eval_axis_mapping,
200        max_examples_per_dataset=max_examples_per_dataset,
201    )

204def _compute_flops(

228def _make_mixture_stage_callback(train_dataset: MixtureDataset, batch_schedule: BatchSchedule):

231    def log_mixture_stage(step_info):
232        nonlocal last_mixture_stage
233        seq_index = batch_schedule.global_data_offset_by_step(step_info.step)
234        block_id = seq_index // train_dataset.block_size
235        stage = train_dataset._get_stage_for_block(block_id)
236        if stage == last_mixture_stage:
237            return
238 
239        weights = train_dataset.weight_stages[stage][1]
240        mixture_log = {f"mixture/weight/{name}": weight for name, weight in weights.items()}
241        mixture_log["mixture/stage"] = stage
242        levanter.tracker.log(mixture_log, step=step_info.step)
243        last_mixture_stage = stage
244 
245    return log_mixture_stage

333def _make_train_step(
334    optimizer: optax.GradientTransformation,
335    mp: jmp.Policy,
336    *,
337    z_loss_weight: float,
338    loss_implementation: str | tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
339    ema_beta: float | None,
340    watch_config: WatchConfig | None = None,
341    backward_flow_config: BackwardFlowConfig | None = None,
342):
343    one = jnp.array(1, dtype=jnp.int32)
344    z_loss = z_loss_weight if z_loss_weight > 0 else None
345    if watch_config is not None:
346        if isinstance(watch_config.watch_targets, str):
347            watch_targets = tuple(t.strip() for t in watch_config.watch_targets.split(","))
348        else:
349            watch_targets = tuple(watch_config.watch_targets)

351        watch_targets = ()

353    @functools.partial(jax.jit, donate_argnums=(0,), static_argnames=("compute_backward_flow", "compute_watch"))
354    def train_step(
355        state: GrugTrainState,
356        batch,
357        *,
358        compute_watch: bool = False,
359        compute_backward_flow: bool = False,
360    ):
361        def loss_fn(params):
362            compute_params = mp.cast_to_compute(params)
363            return compute_params.next_token_loss(
364                batch.tokens,
365                batch.loss_weight,
366                mask=batch.attn_mask,
367                reduction="mean",
368                logsumexp_weight=z_loss,
369                loss_implementation=loss_implementation,
370            )
371 
372        backward_flow_stats = None
373        if backward_flow_config is not None and compute_backward_flow:
374            gradient_scale = jnp.sum(jnp.asarray(batch.loss_weight, dtype=jnp.float32))
375            with capture_backward_flow(backward_flow_config, gradient_scale=gradient_scale):
376                with levanter.tracker.defer_tracker_for_jit() as backward_flow_stats:
377                    loss, grads = jax.value_and_grad(loss_fn)(state.params)
378        else:
379            loss, grads = jax.value_and_grad(loss_fn)(state.params)
380        updates, opt_state = optimizer.update(grads, state.opt_state, state.params)
381        params = optax.apply_updates(state.params, updates)
382 
383        if ema_beta is None:
384            ema_params = None
385        else:
386            if state.ema_params is None:
387                raise ValueError("ema_params must be initialized when ema_beta is set.")
388            ema_params = jax.tree_util.tree_map(
389                lambda old, new: ema_beta * old + (1.0 - ema_beta) * new,
390                state.ema_params,
391                params,
392            )
393 
394        watch_stats = None
395        if watch_config is not None and compute_watch:
396            watch_stats = compute_watch_stats(
397                watch_targets=watch_targets,
398                include_norms=watch_config.include_norms,
399                include_per_parameter_norms=watch_config.include_per_parameter_norms,
400                include_histogram=watch_config.include_histograms,
401                split_scan_layers=watch_config.split_scan_layers,
402                params=state.params,
403                grads=grads,
404                updates=updates,
405                opt_state=state.opt_state,
406                model_tree_type=type(state.params),
407            )
408 
409        next_state = dataclasses.replace(
410            state,
411            step=state.step + one,
412            params=params,
413            opt_state=opt_state,
414            ema_params=ema_params,
415        )
416 
417        metrics = {"train/loss": loss}
418        if backward_flow_stats is not None:
419            metrics[_BACKWARD_FLOW_METRICS_KEY] = backward_flow_stats
420 
421        return next_state, metrics, watch_stats
422 
423    return train_step
424

426def _run_grug_local(config: GrugRunConfig) -> None:
427    """Entry point for the grug template training loop."""
428    trainer = config.trainer.trainer
429    trainer.initialize()
430    levanter.tracker.log_configuration(config)
431 
432    run_id = trainer.id
433    if run_id is None:
434        raise ValueError("trainer.id was not initialized")
435 
436    optimizer = config.optimizer.build(trainer.num_train_steps)
437    watch_config = trainer.watch
438    backward_flow_config = config.trainer.backward_flow if config.trainer.backward_flow.is_enabled else None
439    train_step = _make_train_step(
440        optimizer,
441        trainer.mp,
442        z_loss_weight=config.trainer.z_loss_weight,
443        loss_implementation=config.trainer.loss_implementation,
444        ema_beta=config.trainer.ema_beta,
445        watch_config=watch_config if watch_config.is_enabled else None,
446        backward_flow_config=backward_flow_config,
447    )
448 
449    data_key, model_key = jax.random.split(jax.random.PRNGKey(trainer.seed), 2)
450    if config.trainer.data_seed is not None:
451        data_key = jax.random.PRNGKey(config.trainer.data_seed)
452 
453    # Grug uses raw PartitionSpecs rather than Trainer's logical axis mapping.
454    # Keep the mesh compact so P(("replica_dcn", "data")) spans slices directly.
455    mesh = compact_grug_mesh(context_axis_size=config.trainer.context_axis_size)
456    checkpointer = trainer.checkpointer.create(run_id)
457    with set_mesh(mesh), TrainingDashboard(config, checkpointer.request_checkpoint, run_id):
458        batch_schedule = trainer.batch_schedule
459 
460        train_dataset = build_train_dataset(
461            config.data,
462            max_seq_len=config.model.max_seq_len,
463            batch_schedule=batch_schedule,
464            key=data_key,
465        )
466        train_loader = build_train_loader(
467            train_dataset,
468            batch_schedule=batch_schedule,
469            mesh=mesh,
470            batch_pspec=config.trainer.train_batch_pspec,
471        )
472 
473        @jax.jit
474        def _init_state(model_rng):
475            return initial_state(
476                config.model,
477                optimizer=optimizer,
478                mp=trainer.mp,
479                key=model_rng,
480                ema_beta=config.trainer.ema_beta,
481            )
482 
483        state = _init_state(model_key)
484 
485        state = restore_grug_state_from_checkpoint(
486            state,
487            checkpoint_search_paths=trainer.checkpoint_search_paths(run_id),
488            load_checkpoint_setting=trainer.load_checkpoint,
489            mesh=mesh,
490            allow_partial=trainer.allow_partial_checkpoint,
491        )
492        if trainer.initialize_from is not None:
493            state = init_weights_only_from_checkpoint(
494                state,
495                trainer.initialize_from,
496                mesh=mesh,
497                allow_partial=trainer.allow_partial_checkpoint,
498            )
499        dump_grug_state_sharding_run_artifact(
500            state,
501            log_dir=trainer.log_dir,
502            run_id=run_id,
503            path_override=config.trainer.sharding_dump_path,
504        )
505 
506        levanter.tracker.log_summary({"parameter_count": parameter_count(state.params)})
507 
508        flops_per_example, flops_summary = _compute_flops(model_config=config.model)
509        levanter.tracker.log_summary(flops_summary)
510 
511        eval_cfg = config.eval
512        evaluator = None
513        if eval_cfg is not None:
514            evaluator = build_tagged_evaluator(
515                data_config=config.data,
516                max_seq_len=config.model.max_seq_len,
517                mesh=mesh,
518                eval_cfg=eval_cfg,
519            )
520 
521        profiler_cfg = trainer.profiler
522        profiler_num_steps = profiler_cfg.resolve_num_profile_steps(num_train_steps=trainer.num_train_steps)
523        profiler_enabled = profiler_cfg.is_enabled and profiler_num_steps > 0
524 
525        log_every = max(1, config.trainer.log_every)
526        iterator = LoadingTimeTrackerIterator(train_loader.iter_from_step(int(state.step)))
527 
528        state_callbacks = StateCallbackRunner[GrugTrainState](
529            step_getter=lambda s: s.step,
530            model_getter=lambda s: s.params,
531            eval_model_getter=lambda s: s.ema_params if s.ema_params is not None else s.params,
532            opt_state_getter=lambda s: s.opt_state,
533        )
534        state_callbacks.add_hook(
535            callbacks.log_performance_stats(config.model.max_seq_len, batch_schedule, flops_per_example),
536            every=log_every,
537        )
538        state_callbacks.add_hook(callbacks.pbar_logger(total=trainer.num_train_steps), every=log_every)
539        state_callbacks.add_hook(callbacks.log_step_info(trainer.num_train_steps), every=log_every)
540        if profiler_enabled:
541            state_callbacks.add_hook(
542                profiler_cfg.build(
543                    str(trainer.log_dir / run_id / "profiler"),
544                    run_id=run_id,
545                    num_steps=profiler_num_steps,
546                ),
547                every=1,
548            )
549        state_callbacks.add_hook(_make_mixture_stage_callback(train_dataset, batch_schedule), every=1)
550        if evaluator is not None and eval_cfg is not None:
551            interval = eval_cfg.steps_per_eval
552            eval_ema = eval_cfg.eval_ema and config.trainer.ema_beta is not None
553            if interval is not None and interval > 0 and (eval_cfg.eval_current or eval_ema):
554                state_callbacks.add_hook(
555                    cb_tagged_evaluate(
556                        evaluator,
557                        prefix=eval_cfg.prefix,
558                        eval_current=eval_cfg.eval_current,
559                        eval_ema=eval_ema,
560                    ),
561                    every=interval,
562                )
563 
564        last_loss: float | jax.Array = 0.0
565        last_step_duration = 0.0
566        backward_flow_graph: BackwardFlowGraph | None = None
567 
568        # Main optimization loop.
569        try:
570            while int(state.step) < trainer.num_train_steps:
571                with jax.profiler.TraceAnnotation("load_batch"):
572                    batch = next(iterator)
573                step_start = time.perf_counter()
574                current_step = int(state.step)
575                # grad_watch runs only on its configured interval.
576                compute_watch = (
577                    watch_config.is_enabled and watch_config.interval > 0 and current_step % watch_config.interval == 0
578                )
579                compute_backward_flow = (
580                    backward_flow_config is not None
581                    and backward_flow_config.interval > 0
582                    and current_step % backward_flow_config.interval == 0
583                )
584                state, metrics, watch_stats = train_step(
585                    state,
586                    batch,
587                    compute_watch=compute_watch,
588                    compute_backward_flow=compute_backward_flow,
589                )
590                backward_flow_stats = metrics.get(_BACKWARD_FLOW_METRICS_KEY)
591                if backward_flow_stats is not None:
592                    metrics = {key: value for key, value in metrics.items() if key != _BACKWARD_FLOW_METRICS_KEY}
593                step = int(state.step) - 1
594 
595                jax.block_until_ready(metrics["train/loss"])
596                duration = time.perf_counter() - step_start
597                backward_flow_timing_metrics = None
598                if compute_backward_flow:
599                    backward_flow_timing_metrics = {"backward_flow/compute_step_duration": duration}
600 
601                hook_start = time.perf_counter()
602                with jax.profiler.TraceAnnotation("callbacks"):
603                    state_callbacks.run(state, loss=metrics["train/loss"], step_duration=duration)
604                    last_loss = metrics["train/loss"]
605                    last_step_duration = duration
606                    levanter.tracker.log({"throughput/hook_time": time.perf_counter() - hook_start}, step=step)
607                    levanter.tracker.log({"throughput/loading_time": iterator.this_load_time}, step=step)
608 
609                    if watch_stats is not None:
610                        levanter.tracker.log(watch_stats, step=step)
611                    if backward_flow_timing_metrics is not None:
612                        levanter.tracker.log(backward_flow_timing_metrics, step=step)
613                    if backward_flow_stats:
614                        levanter.tracker.log(backward_flow_stats, step=step)
615                        if backward_flow_graph is None:
616                            backward_flow_graph = _build_backward_flow_graph(
617                                params=state.params,
618                                batch=batch,
619                                mp=trainer.mp,
620                                z_loss_weight=config.trainer.z_loss_weight,
621                            )
622                        artifact_start = time.perf_counter()
623                        _write_backward_flow_artifact(
624                            graph=backward_flow_graph,
625                            backward_flow_metrics=backward_flow_stats,
626                            log_dir=trainer.log_dir,
627                            run_id=run_id,
628                            step=step,
629                        )
630                        levanter.tracker.log(
631                            {"backward_flow/artifact_write_duration": time.perf_counter() - artifact_start},
632                            step=step,
633                        )
634 
635                if checkpointer is not None:
636                    checkpointer.on_step(tree=state, step=int(state.step))
637        except BaseException:
638            logger.exception(
639                "Fatal error in grug training loop; skipping final callbacks/checkpoint to preserve root cause"
640            )
641            raise
642        else:
643            # Mirror classic trainer behavior: force callbacks on the last completed step.
644            state_callbacks.run(state, loss=last_loss, step_duration=last_step_duration, force=True)
645            if checkpointer is not None:
646                checkpointer.on_step(tree=state, step=int(state.step), force=True)
647                checkpointer.wait_until_finished()
648 
649    levanter.tracker.current_tracker().finish()

652def run_grug(config: GrugRunConfig) -> None:

654    trainer = config.trainer.trainer

657 
658    dispatch_grug_training_run(
